rules: Nurse Joy takes your team and gives it back in five seconds. Everyone toasts Nurse Joy.

title: Two Paths
rules: A short path through tall grass, or a long one past a kid yelling about his Pokémon.

title: Rare Candy
rules: A Rare Candy on the ground, a little linty. Your starter is staring at it.

title: Pewter Center
rules: The Pokémon Center smells like antiseptic and Brock's cologne. Everyone breathes in.

title: Mt. Moon Fork
rules: Through the cave, or around it past a Super Nerd guarding a fossil.

title: What? It's Evolving!
rules: Your starter starts glowing in the middle of the road. Everyone hum the evolution music.

title: Cerulean Center
rules: Nurse Joy. Again. Same face, different town. Everyone points at the drawer and asks who she is.

title: Nugget Bridge
rules: Cross the bridge with five trainers on it, or swim under it.

title: Evolution Stone
rules: A shop sells evolution stones for the price of your dignity. Your starter wants one.

title: Celadon Center
rules: Celadon's Pokémon Center has a Game Corner next door. Everyone resists. Toast to resisting.

title: Game Corner
rules: Walk past the Game Corner, or go in and find the poster behind the counter.

title: Fuchsia Center
rules: Fuchsia's Center is next to a zoo with no fences. Everyone makes an animal noise and drinks 1.

title: Cycling Road
rules: Walk the long way, or bike down Cycling Road where the gang hangs out.

title: Rare Candy Stash
rules: You find a Rare Candy behind a vending machine. Your starter is drooling.

title: Saffron Center
rules: Saffron's Center. A Psychic heals you with her mind. Everyone thinks a nice thought and drinks 1.

title: The Fighting Dojo
rules: Walk past the Fighting Dojo, or kick the door in and challenge the Karate King.

title: It's Evolving Again!
rules: Your starter is glowing mid-battle. Everyone hums the music again, louder.

title: Cinnabar Center
rules: A Pokémon Center on a volcano. Nurse Joy is sweating. Everyone wipes their brow.

title: Pokémon Mansion
rules: Go around the burned mansion, or read the diary inside that mentions Mew.

title: Last Center
rules: The last Pokémon Center before the League. Nurse Joy means it this time. Everyone toasts her.

title: The Badge Gate
rules: The gate guard checks your badges. Go quietly, or show off to the trainers waiting past it.

title: Indigo Plateau
rules: The Pokémon Center at the top of Victory Road. Nobody talks. Everyone drinks 1 in silence.

title: Two Ladders
rules: Two ladders. One leads up. The other leads to the Ace Trainers nobody warned you about.

title: Pokédex
rules: Going clockwise, name Pokémon in Pokédex order. First to repeat or skip a number drinks 2.

title: Type Matchup
rules: Name a type. Going clockwise, name a Pokémon of that type. Repeat or blank: drink 2.

title: Who's That?
rules: Describe a Pokémon without naming it. First to guess gives 2. Nobody guesses? Drink 2.

title: Evolution Line
rules: Name a three-stage evolution line. No repeats. First to blank or repeat drinks 2.

title: Cry Alike
rules: Make a Pokémon cry. First to name it gives 2. Whoever is wrong drinks 2.

title: Mareep
rules: Wild Mareep appeared! Grab it by the fluff and roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-2: Static shock to the nipples. Drink 3. 3-4: It headbutts you in the crotch. Drink 2. 5-6: Free wool sweater. Give 2.

title: Unown
rules: Unown used Sobriety Test! Recite the alphabet backwards. Drink 1 for each mistake.

title: Slowpoke
rules: Slowpoke tails are valuable. Cut it off: drink 2. Dick. Leave it: give 1.

title: Zubat
rules: Another fucking Zubat. Roll d6: that's how many bit your neck.
dice: 1d6 — Drink {total}. You're a vampire now: bite someone's neck.

title: Dragonite
rules: Dragonite used Hyper Beam! Give 5, then drink 2 to recharge.

title: Snorlax
rules: A Snorlax blocks the path! Belt out a song of the group's choice or drink 4.

title: Krabby
rules: Krabby used Crabhammer! Pick someone. They drink 5 or finish their drink.

title: Fearow
rules: Fearow used Mirror Move! Do whatever the last player did on their turn.

title: Evolution
rules: Your Pokémon is evolving! Let it evolve: drink 4. Cancel it: give 2.

title: Rival Wally
rules: Rival Wally has asthma and one Ralts. Roll d6: that's how many puffs he needs.
dice: 1d6 — {total} puffs. Drink {total}, you bully.

title: Champion Lance
rules: Champion Lance! Finish a full drink to take his title, or drink 6.

title: Elite Four
rules: Challenge the Elite Four with an underleveled team. Roll 4d6.
dice: 4d6 — 4-10: You win! Give 4 and make a speech. 11-24: Bruno beats your ass. Drink 4.

title: Gym Battle
rules: Gym battle! Roll d6 to see what's on your team.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Six Magikarp. Finish your drink. 2-3: You lose and pay the leader. Drink 3. 4-5: Ugly win. Give 2. 6-6: Clean sweep. Give 4 and strike a pose.

title: Delibird
rules: Delibird used Present! Roll d6 and open it.
dice: 1d6 — 1-3: It's a bomb. Drink {total}. 4-6: It's a gift. Give {total}.

title: Raikou
rules: Raikou appears! Roll d6. 3: catch it and give 5. Anything else: take a bomb shot.
dice: 1d6 — 1-2: Zapped. Take a bomb shot. 3-3: Caught it! Give 5. 4-6: Zapped. Take a bomb shot.

title: Entei
rules: Entei appears! Roll d6. 3: catch it and give 5. Anything else: take a high-proof shot.
dice: 1d6 — 1-2: Burned. Take a high-proof shot. 3-3: Caught it! Give 5. 4-6: Burned. Take a high-proof shot.

title: Suicune
rules: Suicune appears! Roll d6. 3: catch it and give 5. Anything else: shotgun a beer.
dice: 1d6 — 1-2: Blitzed. Shotgun a beer. 3-3: Caught it! Give 5. 4-6: Blitzed. Shotgun a beer.

title: Kyogre
rules: Kyogre rises from the sea! Roll d6. 5-6: catch it; give 5. 1-4: soaked; shotgun a beer.
dice: 1d6 — 1-4: Soaked. Shotgun a beer. 5-6: Caught it! Give 5.

title: Groudon
rules: Groudon wakes! Roll d6. 4-6: catch it; give 4. 1-3: rocked; take a high-proof shot.
dice: 1d6 — 1-3: Rocked. Take a high-proof shot. 4-6: Caught it! Give 4.

title: Rayquaza
rules: Rayquaza descends! Roll d6. 6: catch it; give 6. 1-5: dropped; take a bomb shot.
dice: 1d6 — 1-5: Dropped. Take a bomb shot. 6-6: Caught it! Give 6.

title: Game Corner
rules: The Game Corner slots are rigged by Team Rocket. Roll 2d6 anyway.
dice: 2d6 — 2-6: The house wins. Drink 2. 7-7: Jackpot! Give 7. 8-12: The house wins. Drink 2.

title: Bug Catching Contest
rules: Bug Catching Contest! Roll d6: 1 Paras, 2 Metapod, 3 Beedrill, 4 Butterfree, 5 Pinsir, 6 Scyther.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Paras: awful. Drink 1. 2-2: Metapod: give 1. 3-3: Beedrill: drink 1, give 1. 4-4: Butterfree: give 2. 5-5: Pinsir: drink 2, give 1. 6-6: Scyther: give 3.

title: Safari Zone
rules: Safari Zone! Roll d6. 1-2: bait; give 1. 3-4: throw a rock, dick; drink 4. 5-6: ball; drink 2.
dice: 1d6 — 1-2: Bait. Give 1. 3-4: Rock! Dick move. Drink 4. 5-6: Safari Ball. Drink 2.

title: Rattata
rules: Rattata used Tackle! Roll d6. 1: you fainted; finish your drink. 2-6: give 1.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: You fainted. Finish your drink. 2-6: Give 1.

title: Chansey
rules: Chansey hands you her egg. Don't ask where it came from. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-2: You drop it. Drink 3, egg murderer. 3-5: She takes it back. Drink 1. 6-6: Lucky Egg! Give 4.

title: Poké Ball
rules: Throw a Poké Ball! Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-2: You nail the trainer in the balls. You both drink 2. 3-4: It flees. Drink 3. 5-6: Caught it! Give 3 and name it after someone here.

title: Supersonic
rules: Tentacool used Supersonic! You're confused. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-2: You hurt yourself in confusion. Drink 4. 3-4: Drink 2 with your other hand. 5-6: You snap out of it. Give 2.

title: Missingno
rules: A wild Missingno glitched in! Roll d20. 1-5: the game breaks; everyone drinks 3. Higher: drink 2.
dice: 1d20 — 1-5: The game breaks. Everyone drinks 3. 6-20: Drink 2.

title: Tentacool
rules: Tentacool used Constrict! Drink 2 and hold your drink until you finish it.

title: Machoke
rules: Machoke used Submission! Do anything the group tells you now, or drink 4.

title: Marill
rules: Rain Dance! Perform a song and dance the group chooses, or drink 3.

title: Wartortle
rules: Wartortle used Skull Bash! Crush a beer can against your head to avoid 3 drinks, and give those 3 to one player.

title: Ursaring
rules: Ursaring woke up angry! Drink as many as the group decides, and apologize.

title: Clefairy
rules: Clefairy used Metronome! Close your eyes and point at a player. Whoever you touch drinks 3.

title: Razor Leaf
rules: Bellsprout used Razor Leaf! Shred someone with a callout. They drink 1 in shame.

title: Sudowoodo
rules: A wild Sudowoodo blocks the path! Reveal an embarrassing truth to avoid 2 drinks, and everyone else drinks.

title: Contest Hall
rules: Hoenn Contest Hall! Runway walk to a group-chosen song. Give 5 if you do it; drink 3 if you don't.

title: Spinda
rules: Spinda used Teeter Dance! Dance to a group-chosen song or drink 8.

title: Bicycle
rules: I want to ride my BICYCLE! Sing the line or drink 3. Anyone who joins in drinks 1.

title: Spoink
rules: Spoink's Psychic! Guess the fingers behind your back. Wrong: drink that many. Right: they do.

title: Electrode
rules: Electrode used Selfdestruct! Choose a player and you both finish your drinks.

title: Claydol
rules: Claydol used Double-Edge! Give as many drinks as you want, then drink half in recoil, rounded up.

title: Grimer
rules: Grimer used Sludge Bomb! Have every player combine their drinks in a glass, then finish it!

title: Pelipper
rules: Pelipper used Stockpile! Mix a splash of everyone's drink. Roll d6. Even: swallow it. Odd: choose who drinks it.
dice: 1d6 — 1-5: Spit Up! Choose who drinks it. 2-6: Swallow it.

title: Fiery Path
rules: Fiery Path! Take off an article of clothing. Drink 4 to stay hydrated.

title: Brock
rules: Brock is busy hitting on Nurse Joy. Hit on someone here for him, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Onix flattens you. Drink 10. 2-12: Onix flattens you. Drink 5. 13-19: You chip through. Drink 2. 20-20: Natural 20! Critical hit. Give 6.

title: Misty
rules: Misty's Cascade. Chug for 10 seconds without stopping. Stop early: drink 4 more.

title: Lt. Surge
rules: Lt. Surge wants to see your service record. Salute him and roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-7: Shocked. Drink 4. 8-12: You ground him. Give 4.

title: Erika
rules: Erika's Sleep Powder. Roll d6. Fall asleep and your eyes stay shut until your next turn.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Asleep. Drink 3, eyes shut. 2-2: Asleep. Drink 4, eyes shut. 3-3: Asleep. Drink 5, eyes shut. 4-4: Asleep. Drink 6, eyes shut. 5-6: You shake it off. Give 4.

title: Koga
rules: Ninja test: within 30 seconds, sip someone else's drink without them noticing. Caught: drink 5.

title: Sabrina
rules: Answer 3 yes-or-no questions from the table. Any pause or lie: drink 3.

title: Blaine
rules: Quiz time! The table asks you 3 trivia questions. Get 2 right to win. Each miss: drink 3.

title: Giovanni
rules: The mob boss of Kanto runs a gym on the side. Kiss his ring, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Team Rocket wins. Take two shots and drink 6. 2-10: Team Rocket wins. Take a shot and drink 3. 11-19: You scrape by. Drink 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You beat the boss. Everyone else finishes their drink.

title: Falkner
rules: Drink 3 standing on one foot. Touch down before you finish and you lose: drink 3 more.

title: Bugsy
rules: Bugsy's bugs got in your pants. Roll 3d6 and check your shorts.
dice: 3d6 — 3-3: Bitten. Drink 2. 4-4: Bitten. Drink 2. 5-5: Bitten. Drink 3. 6-6: Bitten. Drink 3. 7-7: Bitten. Drink 4. 8-8: Bitten. Drink 4. 9-9: Bitten. Drink 5. 10-10: Bitten. Drink 5. 11-18: You squash them. Give 4.

title: Whitney
rules: Whitney's Miltank used Rollout. It gets worse every hit. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Rollout hits once. Drink 1. 2-2: Rollout hits twice. Drink 3. 3-3: Three hits. Drink 6. 4-4: Four hits. Drink 10. 5-6: Whitney bursts into tears. Give 5.

title: Morty
rules: Morty's Gastly stares you down. Staring contest with the player opposite. Blink first: drink 4.

title: Chuck
rules: Arm-wrestle the strongest player. Loser drinks 6. If they refuse, they drink 6.

title: Jasmine
rules: Hold a full drink at arm's length for 30 seconds. Lower it: finish it. Make it: give 4.

title: Pryce
rules: Pryce's ice bath. Chug a full glass of ice water without stopping. Stop for air: drink 5.

title: Clair
rules: Clair says you're too weak for dragons. Tell her she's right, then roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-7: Dragonbreath. Drink {total}. 8-12: You tame the dragon. Give {total}.

title: Roxanne
rules: Name 8 Pokémon types in 10 seconds. Drink 2 for each one you miss.

title: Brawly
rules: Ten push-ups in 20 seconds. Fall short: drink 6.

title: Wattson
rules: Wahahaha! Wattson licks a battery and dares you to do the same. Roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-7: Shocked. Drink {total}. 8-12: You lick it first. Give 5.

title: Flannery
rules: Flannery is new and nervous and set the gym on fire. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-4: Burned. Take a high-proof or spicy shot. 5-6: You douse her. Give a shot.

title: Norman
rules: Norman is your dad and he's disappointed. Make the table laugh within 30 seconds or drink 6.

title: Winona
rules: Drink 4 standing on a chair, flapping like a bird. Wobble off or spill: finish your drink.

title: Tate & Liza
rules: Creepy twins. Pick a partner and speak in unison while you roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-7: They outmatch you. You both drink 5. 8-12: You hold them off. You both drink 2.

title: Wallace
rules: Cross the room heel to toe, drink balanced on your head. Spill or wobble: finish it.

title: Roark
rules: Roark shines his miner's headlamp right in your eyes. Squint at him, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Black lung. Finish your drink. 2-3: Cave-in. Drink 4 with your eyes shut. 4-19: You strike coal. Shine your phone light on a player; they drink 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You strike coal. Shine your phone light on a player; they drink 6.

title: Gardenia
rules: Gardenia fears ghosts. Tell her a ghost story in 20 seconds. Table votes not scary: drink 4.

title: Maylene
rules: Maylene fights barefoot. Shoes off, then thumb-wrestle your left neighbor. Lose: drink 5.

title: Crasher Wake
rules: Crasher Wake is a luchador. Put on an imaginary mask, flex at the table, and roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Piledriver. Finish your drink. 2-6: Body slam. Drink 5, then flex again. 7-19: You pin him for three. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You unmask him. Give a shot.

title: Fantina
rules: Fantina wants ze dance. Dance 15 seconds with no music. Table votes not magnifique: drink 5.

title: Byron
rules: Byron is Roark's dad and louder about it. Shout your biggest flex at the table, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Steel beam to the face. Finish your drink. 2-7: Iron Defense. Drink 5, and the table rates your flex out of 10. 8-19: You dent the old man. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You bend his steel. Everyone else drinks 3.

title: Candice
rules: Candice says focus! Hold an ice cube in your bare fist for 30 seconds. Drop it: drink 6.

title: Volkner
rules: Volkner is so bored he blacked out the city. Bore the table with a fun fact, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Blackout. Finish your drink in the dark. 2-8: He yawns at you. Drink 6 and tell another fun fact. 9-19: You spark him up. Whoever yawned during your fact drinks 4. 20-20: Natural 20! He's finally interested. Everyone else drinks 4.

title: Cilan, Chili & Cress
rules: Waiters' test: recite everyone's drink in seat order. Each miss: drink 2. Two misses lose.

title: Lenora
rules: Lenora runs a museum and you're the exhibit. Hold a statue pose while you roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Retaliate. Drink 8 without breaking the pose. 2-4: Retaliate. Drink 4 without breaking the pose. 5-19: You beat the curator. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! Masterpiece. Give 8.

title: Burgh
rules: Burgh is an artist. Draw a bug on your left neighbor's arm. Table can't name it: drink 4.

title: Elesa
rules: Elesa wants a runway walk. Strut to the door and back. The table scores you; under 7 of 10: drink 5.

title: Clay
rules: Clay is a cowboy with a mine and no patience. Tip your hat, partner, and roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Buried in the mine. Finish your drink. 2-6: Earthquake. Drink 5, and say "yeehaw" before every sip until your next turn. 7-19: You strike gold. Everyone tips their hat; the last one drinks 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You strike gold. Everyone tips their hat; the last one drinks 6.

title: Skyla
rules: Skyla is your pilot. Arms out, make engine noises, then roll d20 for turbulence.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Nosedive. Finish your drink. 2-7: Turbulence. Drink 5 while your neighbors shake your chair. 8-19: Smooth landing. The table claps like passengers; give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! Mile-high club. You and a partner give 5 each.

title: Brycen
rules: Brycen was a movie star. Act out a movie; the table has 20 seconds to name it. They can't: drink 6.

title: Drayden
rules: Drayden is the mayor, ancient, and owns a dragon. Make the table a campaign promise, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Impeached. Finish your drink. 2-8: Voted out. Drink 6 and give a concession speech. 9-19: You win the election. Appoint a cabinet: two players drink 3 each. 20-20: Natural 20! Landslide. Everyone else drinks 5.

title: Viola
rules: Viola's photo shoot: hold a pose for 30 seconds while the table heckles. Laugh: drink 4.

title: Grant
rules: Grant makes you climb. Crawl under the table and out the other side, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You fall off the wall. Drink 8 from under the table. 2-4: You fall off the wall. Drink 4 from under the table. 5-19: You top out. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! Free solo. Give 8.

title: Korrina
rules: Korrina's on roller skates. Spin around 5 times, then walk a straight line. Wobble: drink 5.

title: Ramos
rules: Ramos is 90 and tougher than you. Talk like a grumpy grandpa, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Rototilled. Finish your drink. 2-6: Leech Seed. Drink 5, and your right neighbor steals a sip of yours. 7-19: You prune the old man. Give 5, and talk like him until your next turn. 20-20: Natural 20! You prune the old man. Give 10, and talk like him until your next turn.

title: Clemont
rules: Clemont's invention is about to blow. Shout "The future is now, thanks to science!" and roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Singed afro. Finish your drink. 2-6: It explodes. Drink 5 and shout the slogan again. 7-19: It works for once. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! Science! Everyone else drinks 3.

title: Valerie
rules: Valerie's orders: swap a piece of clothing with your right neighbor. Either refuses: both drink 6.

title: Olympia
rules: Olympia has seen your future and it's bleak. Stare into her eyes, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Doomed. Finish your drink. 2-7: As foretold. Drink 6 without breaking eye contact. 8-19: You change fate. Tell a player's future; they drink 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You foresaw her loss. Everyone else drinks 4.

title: Wulfric
rules: Wulfric loves a bear hug. Bear-hug three players while holding your breath. Breathe early: drink 7.

title: Ilima
rules: Ilima is pretty and knows it. Compliment yourself for 10 seconds straight, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Totem Gumshoos. Drink 8 and compliment your left neighbor. 2-3: Totem Gumshoos. Drink 4 and compliment your left neighbor. 4-19: Trial cleared. Pick a player: they compliment themselves for 10 seconds or drink 3. 20-20: Natural 20! Prettier than Ilima. Give 6.

title: Hala
rules: Hala wants a sumo match. Palm-push your right neighbor; first to move a foot loses. Lose: drink 5.

title: Lana
rules: Lana lies about everything. Tell two truths and a lie. The table spots the lie: drink 5.

title: Kiawe
rules: Kiawe's fire dance. Shirt off or hips going, the table picks. Then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Third-degree burns. Take a spicy shot. 2-6: Burned. Drink 5 and keep dancing. 7-19: Totem Marowak falls. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! Inferno Overdrive. Give a shot.

title: Mallow
rules: Mallow's cooking: pour a splash of three players' drinks into yours, then down it. Gag: drink 6.

title: Olivia
rules: Olivia just got dumped again. Tell her about your worst breakup, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! She dates your ex. Finish your drink. 2-7: She cries on you. Drink 6 and hug your left neighbor. 8-19: You cheer her up. Whoever had the most recent breakup drinks 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You cheer her up. Whoever had the most recent breakup drinks 8.

title: Nanu
rules: Nanu's a cop who can't be bothered. Get anyone here to confess a crime in 30 seconds or drink 6.

title: Hapu
rules: Hapu's Mudsdale stomps. Stomp your feet like a horse, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Buried in mud. Finish your drink. 2-8: Trampled. Drink 7, and stomp before every sip until your next turn. 9-19: You ride her horse. Pick a player: they neigh for you or drink 4. 20-20: Natural 20! Island Kahuna. Everyone else drinks 4.

title: Milo
rules: Milo herds Wooloo. Baa like a sheep for 20 seconds. Nobody laughs: drink 4.

title: Nessa
rules: Nessa is a model and you are not. Pout for the camera, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Gigantamax Drednaw. Finish your drink. 2-4: Drowned in looks. Drink 4 and keep pouting. 5-19: You make the cover. Pick a player: they strike a pose or drink 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You make the cover. Pick a player: they strike a pose or drink 6.

title: Kabu
rules: Kabu jogs every morning. Do ten jumping jacks, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Fire Spin. Take a spicy shot. 2-5: Burnt out. Drink 5, then ten more jumping jacks. 6-19: You outlast the old man. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You outlast the old man. Give 10.

title: Bea
rules: Bea trains hard. Hold a plank for 30 seconds. Drop early: drink 6.

title: Opal
rules: Opal wants a pink successor. Name 5 pink things in 10 seconds. Miss one: drink 5.

title: Gordie
rules: Gordie's mom runs the next gym and he won't shut up about it. Yell "MOM!" then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Gigantamax Coalossal. Finish your drink. 2-7: Stealth Rock. Drink 5 and yell for your mom again. 8-19: Mama's boy goes down. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You call his mom. Everyone else drinks 3.

title: Piers
rules: Piers is a punk. Scream a verse of any song like you mean it. Table votes not punk enough: drink 6.

title: Raihan
rules: Raihan takes a selfie mid-battle. Pose for his phone, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Posted and roasted. Finish your drink. 2-8: Sandstorm. Drink 6, and the table writes your caption. 9-19: You trend. Take a selfie with a player; they drink 4. 20-20: Natural 20! Most-liked post ever. Everyone else drinks 4.

title: Katy
rules: Katy baked you a cake and her bugs got in the batter. Take a big bite of nothing, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You found a leg. Finish your drink. 2-3: Sticky Web. Drink 4, and keep your elbows on the table until your next turn. 4-19: Sugar crash for Katy. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! Sugar crash for Katy. Give 6.

title: Brassius
rules: Brassius demands art. Sculpt a Pokémon from a napkin in 20 seconds. Table can't name it: drink 4.

title: Iono
rules: Iono is streaming this. Say hi to chat in your best influencer voice, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Banned from chat. Finish your drink. 2-5: Chat hates you. Drink 4 and read your own hate comment aloud. 6-19: You're trending. Shout out a player by name; they drink 3. 20-20: Natural 20! Top donor. Give 8.

title: Kofu
rules: Kofu sells fish. Sell your drink to the table in 20 seconds. Nobody buys it: drink 5.

title: Larry
rules: Larry is a tired salaryman. Do your saddest desk-job sigh, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Performance review. Finish your drink. 2-6: Overtime. Drink 5 and sigh again. 7-19: You clock out early. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! Promoted. Give a shot.

title: Ryme
rules: Ryme is a rapper. Freestyle four bars about your left neighbor. Table votes trash: drink 6.

title: Tulip
rules: Tulip does your makeup. Shut your eyes while your left neighbor finger-paints your face. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Clown face. Finish your drink. 2-7: Hideous. Drink 6, and keep the face paint until your next turn. 8-19: Gorgeous. You and your makeup artist give 3 each. 20-20: Natural 20! Supermodel. Everyone else drinks 4.

title: Grusha
rules: Grusha wrecked his knees snowboarding. Wall-sit for 30 seconds. Drop early: drink 7.

title: Articuno
rules: Articuno freezes the table. Everyone shivers dramatically while you roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Frozen. Everyone drinks 6; the first to stop shivering drinks 4 more. 2-13: Frozen. Everyone drinks 3; the first to stop shivering drinks 2 more. 14-19: Caught! Give 8. 20-20: Natural 20! Caught! Give 16.

title: Zapdos
rules: Zapdos used Thunder. Hold hands with both neighbors to ground it, then roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-7: Struck. You and both neighbors drink {total}. 8-12: Caught! Give {total}.

title: Moltres
rules: Moltres is on fire and so is your throat. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Scorched. Take two high-proof shots. 2-12: Scorched. Take a high-proof shot. 13-19: Caught! Give a shot. 20-20: Natural 20! Caught! Give two shots.

title: Mewtwo
rules: Mewtwo reads your mind and tells the table your worst thought. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Overpowered. Finish your drink, then a fresh one. 2-7: Overpowered. Finish your drink. 8-19: You hold on. Pick a player: they share their worst thought or drink 4. 20-20: Natural 20! Caught! Everyone else finishes their drink.

title: Mew
rules: Mew is invisible, pink and giggling at you. Shut your eyes, point at a player, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It giggles off. You and whoever you pointed at drink 6. 2-7: It giggles off. You and whoever you pointed at drink 3. 8-19: Got it by the tail. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! It was under the truck. Give 8.

title: Lugia
rules: Lugia floods the table. Roll d20; miss it and everyone drinks that many seconds.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It floods the table. Everyone drinks for 5 seconds. 2-7: Aeroblast. Everyone drinks for {total} seconds. 8-19: Caught! Everyone else drinks for 10 seconds. 20-20: Natural 20! Caught! Everyone else drinks for 20 seconds.

title: Ho-Oh
rules: Ho-Oh used Sacred Fire. It burns going down and comes back twice as hot. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Drink 1, then give 2. 2-2: Drink 2, then give 4. 3-3: Drink 3, then give 6. 4-4: Drink 4, then give 8. 5-5: Drink 5, then give 10. 6-6: Drink 6, then give 12.

title: Raikou, Entei, Suicune
rules: Three dogs, and they run the moment you look at them. Point at the guiltiest player, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! All three bite. Finish your drink. 2-7: It ran away. Again. You and the guilty one drink 3. 8-19: Cornered one. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! Cornered one. Give 8.

title: Celebi
rules: Celebi travels in time. Relive your most regrettable night out for the table, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It makes you live it again. Drink 10 and tell the ending you skipped. 2-7: It makes you live it again. Drink 5 and tell the ending you skipped. 8-19: You rewrite history. Pick a player: they tell their worst night out or drink 4. 20-20: Natural 20! That night never happened. Give 8.

title: Latias & Latios
rules: Pick a partner. Spoon them while you roll 2d6. 8 or more, or doubles, catches the pair.
dice: 2d6 — 2-2: They slip away. You both drink 1. 3-3: They slip away. You both drink 2. 4-4: They slip away. You both drink 2. 5-5: They slip away. You both drink 3. 6-6: They slip away. You both drink 3. 7-7: They slip away. You both drink 4. 8-12: Caught both! You both give 6.

title: Deoxys
rules: A space virus with a laser. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Psycho Boost lands. Drink 12; anyone who uncovered their mouth drinks 4. 2-7: Psycho Boost lands. Drink 6; anyone who uncovered their mouth drinks 2. 8-19: Caught! Give 6. 20-20: Natural 20! Caught clean! Give 10.

title: Groudon
rules: Groudon dried up the oceans, and now your drink. Drink 2, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Precipice Blades. Take a spicy shot. 2-7: Drought. Drink 4, and no water until your next turn. 8-19: You crack its crust. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You crack its crust. Give 10.

title: Kyogre
rules: Kyogre is flooding the world. Everyone drinks 2 to lower the sea, then you roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Tidal wave. You and both neighbors drink 6. 2-7: Tidal wave. You and both neighbors drink 3. 8-19: You surf it. Give 5, arms out. 20-20: Natural 20! You drain the ocean. Everyone else drinks 4.

title: Rayquaza
rules: Rayquaza came down from space to stop a fight. Name the two players likeliest to brawl. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Dragon Ascent. You and both brawlers drink 6. 2-7: Dragon Ascent. You and both brawlers drink 3. 8-19: You ride the dragon. The two brawlers hug it out or drink 4 each. 20-20: Natural 20! You ride the dragon. The two brawlers hug it out or drink 8 each.

title: The Regi Trio
rules: Three golems behind a puzzle nobody solved without a guide. Admit you used one, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Three Explosions. Finish your drink. 2-7: Explosion. Drink 5, and admit what else you looked up a guide for. 8-19: You crack the code. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You crack the code. Give 10.

title: Dialga
rules: Dialga controls time. Drink for exactly 5 seconds, counted out loud by the table, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Roar of Time. Drink 10, and talk in slow motion until your next turn. 2-7: Roar of Time. Drink 5, and talk in slow motion until your next turn. 8-19: Time is on your side. Pick a player: they drink for 5 seconds, counted by the table. 20-20: Natural 20! Time stops for you. Everyone else drinks 4.

title: Palkia
rules: Palkia bends space. Swap seats with the player farthest from you, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Spacial Rend. Drink 10, then swap seats again. 2-7: Spacial Rend. Drink 5, then swap seats again. 8-19: You close the rift. Whoever is farthest from you now drinks 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You close the rift. Whoever is farthest from you now drinks 6.

title: Giratina
rules: Giratina lives in a world turned backwards. Say your name backwards, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Lost in the Distortion World. Finish your drink. 2-7: Shadow Force. Drink 5; the table calls you your backwards name until your next turn. 8-19: You drag it out. Pick a player: they say their name backwards or drink 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You drag it out. Pick a player: they say their name backwards or drink 6.

title: Darkrai
rules: Darkrai feeds on nightmares. Tell the table your weirdest sex dream, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Sleep paralysis. Finish your drink. 2-7: Bad dream. Drink 5 while the table interprets it. 8-19: You wake up. Anyone who's had that dream too drinks 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You wake up. Anyone who's had that dream too drinks 6.

title: Arceus
rules: Arceus is literally God. Pray out loud for 5 seconds, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Smited. Finish your drink. 2-7: Judgment. Drink 6 and confess one sin to the table. 8-19: God blinks. Give 6. 20-20: Natural 20! You caught God. Everyone else finishes their drink.

title: Reshiram
rules: Reshiram seeks truth. Tell the table the truth about your last hookup, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Blue Flare. Drink 10, and the table asks one follow-up question. 2-7: Blue Flare. Drink 5, and the table asks one follow-up question. 8-19: The truth wins. Pick a player: they tell the truth about theirs or drink 4. 20-20: Natural 20! The truth wins. Pick a player: they tell the truth about theirs or drink 8.

title: Zekrom
rules: Zekrom seeks ideals. Toast your most delusional ambition, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Fusion Bolt. Finish your drink. 2-7: Bolt Strike. Drink 5 while the table rates your ambition out of 10. 8-19: Your ideals win. Everyone else toasts your ambition and drinks 2. 20-20: Natural 20! Your ideals win. Everyone else toasts your ambition and drinks 4.

title: Xerneas
rules: Xerneas gives life. Give the sleepiest player a pep talk until they perk up, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Geomancy. Drink 10, and the sleepy player drinks 4. 2-7: Geomancy. Drink 5, and the sleepy player drinks 2. 8-19: Full of life. You and the sleepy player give 3 each. 20-20: Natural 20! Full of life. You and the sleepy player give 6 each.

title: Yveltal
rules: Yveltal drains life. Name the deadest-looking player; they drink 2. Then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Drained dry. Finish your drink. 2-7: Oblivion Wing. Drink 5 and play dead for 10 seconds. 8-19: You live. The deadest-looking player drinks 3 more. 20-20: Natural 20! You live. The deadest-looking player drinks 6 more.

title: Tapu Koko
rules: Tapu Koko guards the island and is an asshole about it. Bow to the island, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Electric Terrain. Drink 10 and bow to the island again, deeper. 2-7: Electric Terrain. Drink 5 and bow to the island again, deeper. 8-19: You earn its respect. Everyone else bows to you; the worst bow drinks 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You earn its respect. Everyone else bows to you; the worst bow drinks 6.

title: Necrozma
rules: Necrozma ate the light. Shut your eyes, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Blinded. Finish your drink. 2-7: Prismatic Laser. Drink 6 with your eyes still shut. 8-19: The light comes back. Open your eyes; the first player you see drinks 4. 20-20: Natural 20! The light comes back. Open your eyes; the first player you see drinks 8.

title: Zacian
rules: Zacian is a dog with a sword in its mouth. Bark, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Behemoth Blade. Drink 10 and fetch something for the table. 2-7: Behemoth Blade. Drink 5 and fetch something for the table. 8-19: Good dog. Everyone pets you; give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! Belly rubs. Give 8.

title: Eternatus
rules: Eternatus is a giant space worm. Everyone looks up, then you roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! The Darkest Day. Finish your drink. 2-7: Eternabeam. Drink 6 while everyone keeps looking up. 8-19: You end the Darkest Day. The last player still looking up drinks 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You end the Darkest Day. The last player still looking up drinks 8.

title: Koraidon
rules: Koraidon is your motorcycle. Make engine noises and lean into a turn, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Road rash. Finish your drink. 2-7: Wipeout. Drink 5, and walk your bike: stand until your next turn. 8-19: Wheelie. Pick a passenger; you both give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! Wheelie. Pick a passenger; you both give 6.

title: Miraidon
rules: Miraidon is a robot dragon bike from the future. Predict tomorrow's hangover, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Electro Drift. Drink 10; your hangover prediction just got worse. 2-7: Electro Drift. Drink 5; your hangover prediction just got worse. 8-19: The future's bright. Predict a player's hangover; they drink 3. 20-20: Natural 20! The future's bright. Predict a player's hangover; they drink 6.

title: Lorelei
rules: Chug a glass of ice water, then roll d6. Lorelei likes it cold.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Brain freeze. Drink 1. 2-2: Brain freeze. Drink 2. 3-3: Brain freeze. Drink 3. 4-4: Brain freeze. Drink 4. 5-5: You keep it down. Give 5. 6-6: You keep it down. Give 6.

title: Bruno
rules: Arm-wrestle the two strongest players back to back. Each loss: drink 5.

title: Agatha
rules: Drink 3. Until your next turn you can't say anyone's name. Each slip: drink 3.

title: Will
rules: The table secretly picks a number from 1 to 10. Three guesses; each miss: drink 2.

title: Karen
rules: Tell the table something you've never told them, or finish your drink.

title: Sidney
rules: Sidney thinks you're a little bitch. Prove him wrong: roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-6: Crunched. Finish your drink. 7-7: A standoff. Drink 7. 8-12: You beat him. Give 5.

title: Phoebe
rules: Eyes shut; someone swaps drinks with you. Guess who, or drink 4 of theirs.

title: Glacia
rules: Glacia says your drink is warm and your heart is too. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Sheer Cold. Drink 12, and give your left neighbor the cold shoulder until your next turn. 2-12: Sheer Cold. Drink 6, and give your left neighbor the cold shoulder until your next turn. 13-19: You thaw out. Drink 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You shatter her ice. Give 8.

title: Drake
rules: Drake is a sailor. Drink like one. Roll 3d6.
dice: 3d6 — 3-3: Drink 4. 4-4: Drink 4. 5-5: Drink 5. 6-6: Drink 5. 7-7: Drink 6. 8-8: Drink 6. 9-9: Drink 7. 10-10: Drink 7. 11-11: Drink 8. 12-18: You outdrink a sailor. Give 6.

title: Aaron
rules: Aaron loves bugs. Eat a crumb off the floor, or fake it well, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Bug Bite. Drink 10 and buzz for five seconds. 2-7: Bug Bite. Drink 5 and buzz for five seconds. 8-19: You squash his bugs. Slap the table and give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You squash his bugs. Slap the table and give 10.

title: Bertha
rules: Grandma Bertha asks about your love life. Answer every question for 20 seconds. Dodge one: drink 5.

title: Flint
rules: Flint's afro is on fire again. Fluff your hair at the table, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Flare Blitz. Take a spicy shot. 2-7: Singed. Drink 5, and keep your hair fluffed until your next turn. 8-19: You put out the afro. Pat out your left neighbor's head; they drink 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You put out the afro. Pat out your left neighbor's head; they drink 6.

title: Lucian
rules: Lucian reads mid-battle. Read your last sent text aloud, dramatically. Refuse: finish your drink.

title: Shauntal
rules: Shauntal writes smut about trainers. Narrate 20 seconds of it about two players. Stop: drink 5.

title: Grimsley
rules: Grimsley bets your drink on this. Push it into the middle of the table, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You lost the house. Finish your drink. 2-7: House wins. Drink 6 from the drink in the middle. 8-19: Jackpot. Take your drink back and give 6. 20-20: Natural 20! Royal flush. Everyone else drinks 4.

title: Caitlin
rules: Caitlin naps mid-battle. Fake-snore through a whole sip. Laugh or spill: drink 5.

title: Marshal
rules: Marshal trains under waterfalls. Flick some water on your own face, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Black belt to the face. Finish your drink. 2-7: Close Combat. Drink 5 and flick more water on your face. 8-19: You knock him out. Give 5 with a bow. 20-20: Natural 20! You knock him out. Give 10 with a bow.

title: Malva
rules: Malva reads the news. Break a scandal about a player in your anchor voice. Nobody laughs: drink 5.

title: Siebold
rules: Siebold is a chef. Describe your drink's flavor like a snob critic, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Sent back to the kitchen. Drink 10 and describe your drink again, nicer. 2-7: Sent back to the kitchen. Drink 5 and describe your drink again, nicer. 8-19: Michelin star. Critique a player's drink; they drink 3. 20-20: Natural 20! Michelin star. Critique a player's drink; they drink 6.

title: Wikstrom
rules: Sir Wikstrom wants a duel. Straw-fence your right neighbor; first one poked loses. Lose: drink 5.

title: Drasna
rules: Drasna is a sweet granny with four dragons. Kiss your left neighbor's cheek, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Granny's dragon. Finish your drink. 2-7: Dragon Pulse. Drink 6, and your left neighbor pinches your cheek. 8-19: Granny's proud and slips you cookie money. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! Granny's proud and slips you cookie money. Give 10.

title: Acerola
rules: Hide your drink. Acerola (your left neighbor) gets 15 seconds to find it. Found: drink 5.

title: Kahili
rules: Kahili golfs. Flick a bottle cap into a cup across the table in 3 tries. Miss all three: drink 5.

title: Molayne
rules: Molayne fixes computers. Let the table read your last web search, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Clear your history. Finish your drink. 2-7: Flash Cannon. Drink 5, and the table reads one more search. 8-19: You reboot him. Pick a player: the table reads their last search or they drink 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You reboot him. Pick a player: the table reads their last search or they drink 8.

title: Marnie
rules: Lead the table in a Team Yell chant for Marnie. Anyone doesn't join in: you drink 5.

title: Hop
rules: Hop is Leon's little brother and he won't stop saying so. Say "Mate!" then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Still not Leon. Drink 10, and say "mate" before every sip until your next turn. 2-7: Still not Leon. Drink 5, and say "mate" before every sip until your next turn. 8-19: He cries to his brother. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! Unbeatable! Everyone else drinks 3.

title: Bede
rules: Bede is a spoiled brat. Throw a 10-second tantrum. Table votes not bratty enough: drink 5.

title: Allister
rules: Allister hides behind a mask. Cover your face with your hands, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Gigantamax Gengar. Finish your drink. 2-7: Shadow Ball. Drink 5 with your face still covered. 8-19: Peekaboo! The first player to flinch drinks 4. 20-20: Natural 20! Peekaboo! The first player to flinch drinks 8.

title: Rika
rules: Rika runs the interview. Name your three worst habits in 10 seconds. Stall: drink 5.

title: Poppy
rules: Poppy is eight and has a hammer. Let your left neighbor bonk your head, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Bonked silly. Finish your drink. 2-7: Gigaton Hammer. Drink 5, and she bonks you again. 8-19: You take her toy. Bonk a player once; they drink 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You take her toy. Bonk a player once; they drink 6.

title: Larry
rules: It's Larry again. He's on unpaid overtime. Sigh with him, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Unpaid overtime. Drink 12 and sigh again, sadder. 2-7: Unpaid overtime. Drink 6 and sigh again, sadder. 8-19: Larry gets to go home. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! Larry smiles. Everyone else drinks 4.

title: Hassel
rules: Hassel weeps at art. Describe the table like a painting. Nobody laughs or tears up: drink 5.

title: Crispin
rules: Crispin is on nine energy drinks. Talk at double speed for 10 seconds, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Heart palpitations. Finish your drink. 2-7: Burnout. Drink 5, then talk at half speed until your next turn. 8-19: He crashes. Whoever looks most tired drinks 3. 20-20: Natural 20! He crashes. Whoever looks most tired drinks 6.

title: Amarys
rules: Amarys doesn't do friends. Get your right neighbor to say "friend" in 30 seconds. Fail: drink 5.

title: Lacey
rules: Lacey's quiz: spell your full name backwards in 10 seconds. Slip once: drink 5.

title: Drayton
rules: Drayton couldn't be bothered to read this card. Neither could you. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He beats you without trying. Drink 12. 2-7: He beats you without trying. Drink 6. 8-19: You tried harder. Give 5, with minimal effort. 20-20: Natural 20! You tried harder. Give 10, with minimal effort.

title: Blue
rules: Your rival got here first and smells like your mom's perfume. The whole table fights. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Blue smells you. Everyone finishes their drink, then a fresh one. 2-5: Blue smells you. Everyone finishes their drink. 6-10: Close fight. Everyone drinks 4 and says "smell ya later." 11-19: Champion! Hand out 10 and take a victory lap. 20-20: Natural 20! Champion! Hand out 20 and take a victory lap.

title: Red
rules: Red hasn't spoken in 25 years. The whole table fights in silence. Anyone talks: drink 2. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Red says nothing. Everyone finishes their drink. 2-7: Pikachu Volt Tackles the table. Everyone drinks 4 in silence. 8-19: A hit on Mt. Silver. Everyone who stayed silent gives 2. 20-20: Natural 20! Red nods once. Give 10.

title: Lance
rules: Lance used Hyper Beam on the whole table. Roll d20 and pray.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Hyper Beam sweeps the table. Everyone finishes their drink, then a fresh one. 2-5: Hyper Beam sweeps the table. Everyone finishes their drink. 6-10: Dragonite's Outrage. Everyone drinks 3 and yells. 11-19: Hall of Fame! Make a rule for the rest of the game. 20-20: Natural 20! Hall of Fame! Make two rules for the rest of the game.

title: Steven
rules: Steven wants to show the whole table his rock collection. Roll 2d6 to escape.
dice: 2d6 — 2-7: Meteor Mash. Everyone drinks {total}. 8-12: Champion! Give {total}, split however you like.

title: Wallace
rules: Wallace demands a beautiful fight. The whole table strikes its most fabulous pose, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Milotic sweeps. Everyone finishes their drink. 2-7: Ugly. Everyone drinks 3; the table names the ugliest pose and that player drinks 2 more. 8-19: Stunning hit. The table names the best pose; that player gives 4. 20-20: Natural 20! Contest winner. Make a rule for the rest of the game.

title: Cynthia
rules: Cynthia's Garchomp has never lost. The whole table holds hands and prays, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Garchomp sweeps the table. Everyone finishes their drink. 2-7: Earthquake. Everyone drinks 4 without letting go of hands. 8-19: Garchomp flinches. Give 4, and everyone lets go. 20-20: Natural 20! Cynthia drops her hair clip. Give 10.

title: Alder
rules: Alder skipped work to get drunk with you. The whole table cheers him, then you roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He's still up at 4 a.m. Everyone finishes their drink. 2-7: Volcarona burns the table. Everyone drinks 3 and blows on their fingers. 8-19: Alder spills his beer on you. Give 4 and sip anyone's drink. 20-20: Natural 20! Alder passes out. Give 10.

title: Iris
rules: Iris is the Champion and she's literally a child. The whole table fights a kid. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Outrage. Everyone finishes their drink. 2-7: Beaten by a child. Everyone drinks 4 and apologizes to her. 8-19: You land one on a kid. The table boos you; give 4 anyway. 20-20: Natural 20! She sends you to bed. Give 10.

title: Diantha
rules: Diantha is a movie star. The whole table acts out a dramatic death, then you roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Box-office flop. Everyone finishes their drink. 2-7: Moonblast. Everyone drinks 4; the worst death scene drinks 2 more. 8-19: An award-worthy hit. Thank the Academy, then give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! Standing ovation. Give 10.

title: Professor Kukui
rules: Professor Kukui fights shirtless in a lab coat. The whole table yells "Woo!" Then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Lab coat to the face. Everyone finishes their drink. 2-7: Woo! Everyone drinks 3 and flexes. 8-19: A hit, cousin! Pick a cousin at the table; you both give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! Woo! Give 10.

title: Leon
rules: Leon is unbeaten and always lost. Everyone strikes the Charizard pose. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Still undefeated. Everyone finishes their drink. 2-7: Max Wildfire. Everyone drinks 4, still holding the pose. 8-19: Leon got lost on the way back. Point in a random direction and give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! His cape falls off. Give 10.

title: Geeta
rules: Geeta booked your fight in a meeting. The whole table says "per my last email." Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Mandatory overtime. Everyone finishes their drink. 2-7: Tera Blast. Everyone drinks 4 and replies all. 8-19: The meeting ends early. Give 4 and leave the room for five seconds. 20-20: Natural 20! You're the boss now. Give 10.

title: Nemona
rules: Nemona wants to battle you again. And again. And again. The whole table fights. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! One more battle! Everyone finishes their drink. 2-7: Rematch! Everyone drinks 3 and says "one more!" 8-19: She loves it. Give 4, and hug your left neighbor for her. 20-20: Natural 20! She finally needs a nap. Give 10.

title: Pidgey
rules: Wild Pidgey appeared! Shield your eyes and roll d6 for its move.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Sand Attack, right in the eyes. Drink 2 with them shut. 2-2: Gust. Your hair is ruined. Give 1. 3-3: Tackle. Adorable. Give 2. 4-4: Quick Attack, into a window. Give 2. 5-5: It pecks your left neighbor instead. They drink 2. 6-6: Whirlwind blows it into the next town. Give 3.

title: Rattata
rules: Wild Rattata appeared! It is chewing on your shoelaces like it pays rent. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It bites your ankle. Drink 4 and limp until your next turn. 2-3: It bites your ankle. Drink 2 and limp until your next turn. 4-19: Evicted. Whoever has the worst shoes drinks 2. 20-20: Natural 20! Evicted. Whoever has the worst shoes drinks 4.

title: Zigzagoon
rules: Wild Zigzagoon is zigzagging toward you. Zigzag your head with it and roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You zag straight into a wall. Drink 3 and sit on the floor. 2-3: Dizzy. Drink {total}. 4-19: Pickup! Steal a sip from any drink at the table. 20-20: Natural 20! Pickup! Steal two sips from any drink at the table.

title: Bidoof
rules: Wild Bidoof appeared, with the dead eyes of a man on his fourth divorce. Roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-4: It stares into your soul. Drink 2 without blinking. 5-12: Bidoof wanders off to find wife five. Give 2.

title: Wooloo
rules: Wild Wooloo rolls at you like a drunk sheep down a hill. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Bowled over. Drink 4, then baa like you mean it. 2-3: Bowled over. Drink 2, then baa like you mean it. 4-19: You hop it like a hurdle. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You shear it and keep the sweater. Give 4.

title: Lechonk
rules: Wild Lechonk is snorting your snacks. Everyone oinks at it; the drawer rolls d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It eats the whole bag. Drink 4, and oink before every sip until your next turn. 2-3: It eats the whole bag. Drink 2, and oink before every sip until your next turn. 4-19: Bacon later. The quietest oinker drinks 2. 20-20: Natural 20! Bacon later. The quietest oinker drinks 4.

title: Youngster Joey
rules: Joey says his Rattata is in the top percentage of Rattata. Prove him wrong. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It was. Drink 6 and apologize to Joey. 2-3: It was. Drink 3 and apologize to Joey. 4-19: Top percentage, bottom of the bracket. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! Top percentage, bottom of the bracket. Give 4.

title: Bug Catcher
rules: A bug catcher in short shorts bets you can't name five bug Pokémon in ten seconds. Lose: drink 2.

title: One-Way Ledge
rules: You hop the ledge and can never go back up. Your ankle has opinions. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Rolled it. Drink 4 standing on your good foot. 2-6: Rolled it. Drink 2 standing on your good foot. 7-19: Stuck the landing. Give 1 and take a bow. 20-20: Natural 20! Stuck the landing. Give 2 and take a bow.

title: Mystery Egg
rules: A stranger in a trench coat hands you an egg. It's warm. Too warm.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It hatches into a Togepi and pisses on you. Drink 6. 2-8: It hatches into a Togepi and pisses on you. Drink 3. 9-19: It's a pack of ammo for the bag. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! It's a pack of ammo for the bag. Give 4.

title: Ace Trainer Kenny
rules: Kenny has trained since he was four, and his Rattata is in its prime. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: He explains EV training at length. Drink 3. 2-2: Rattata crits. Drink 3 and say "good game, Kenny." 3-3: Kenny cries. Give 3. 4-4: Kenny calls his mom. Give 3. 5-5: Kenny quits forever. Give 4. 6-6: Kenny gives you his hat. Give 4.

title: Lass Tiffany
rules: Lass Tiffany says you looked at her. Battle to prove you didn't. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You did. Drink 6, and look only at the floor until your next turn. 2-6: You did. Drink 3, and look only at the floor until your next turn. 7-19: She leaves you a Protect out of respect. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! She leaves you a Protect out of respect. Give 6.

title: Spearow
rules: Wild Spearow is angrier than any bird has a right to be. Roll d6 for its move.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Fury Attack: four pecks. Drink 4. 2-2: Peck. Rude. Give 1. 3-3: Leer. You leer back harder. Give 2. 4-4: Growl. Everyone growls at it; the quietest drinks 2. 5-5: It flies off to bother Ash. Give 2. 6-6: Drill Peck misses and hits your right neighbor. They drink 3.

title: Ekans
rules: Wild Ekans wraps around your leg and hisses something filthy. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Wrap. Drink 4, and drink with crossed arms until your next turn. 2-4: Wrap. Drink 2, and drink with crossed arms until your next turn. 5-19: You tie it in a knot. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You tie it in a knot. Give 4.

title: Wurmple
rules: Wild Wurmple appeared! Nobody knows what it becomes. Not even Wurmple. Roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-4: Existential dread. Drink 2 and name your biggest regret. 5-12: It becomes a footnote. Give 2.

title: Starly
rules: A whole flock of Starly. Everyone flaps their arms. The drawer rolls d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Swarmed. Drink 4; the worst flapper drinks with you. 2-4: Swarmed. Drink 2; the worst flapper drinks with you. 5-19: They scatter. The last one still flapping drinks 2. 20-20: Natural 20! They scatter. The last one still flapping drinks 4.

title: Lillipup
rules: Wild Lillipup wants belly rubs. Rub the nearest belly at the table, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It humps your leg. Drink 4 and apologize to the leg. 2-4: It humps your leg. Drink 2 and apologize to the leg. 5-19: Good dog. You and the belly you rubbed give 2 each. 20-20: Natural 20! Good dog. You and the belly you rubbed give 4 each.

title: Yungoos
rules: Wild Yungoos is a sausage with teeth and a bad attitude. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It bites your sausage. Drink 6 and cross your legs until your next turn. 2-4: It bites your sausage. Drink 3 and cross your legs until your next turn. 5-19: Sausage served. Whoever has the longest name drinks 2. 20-20: Natural 20! Sausage served. Whoever has the longest name drinks 4.

title: Hiker Dave
rules: Hiker Dave hasn't showered since Mt. Moon and wants a hug. Hug your left neighbor, roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Geodude to the face. Drink 6 and hug him again. 2-4: Geodude to the face. Drink 3 and hug him again. 5-19: Dave heads back up the mountain. Your left neighbor drinks 2 for the smell. 20-20: Natural 20! Dave heads back up the mountain. Your left neighbor drinks 4 for the smell.

title: Picnicker Gina
rules: Picnicker Gina dares you to eat something off the floor. Do it or drink 3.

title: Zubat Cave
rules: Mt. Moon. No Repel. Zubat every step. Roll d6 for how many.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Six Zubat. Drink 3 and bite a neck. 2-2: Five Zubat. Drink 2, flapping. 3-3: Two Zubat. Give 1. 4-4: One Zubat. Give 1. 5-5: A Clefairy instead. Give 2. 6-6: No Zubat at all. A miracle. Give 3.

title: Super Nerd Miguel
rules: Miguel will fight you for the Helix Fossil. He's been here for weeks. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He wins and explains why. Drink 6 and say "Praise Helix." 2-7: He wins and explains why. Drink 3 and say "Praise Helix." 8-19: You take the fossil. Everyone yells "Praise Helix!"; the last one drinks 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You take the fossil. Everyone yells "Praise Helix!"; the last one drinks 6.

title: Twins Amy & May
rules: Double battle, and both twins talk at once. Pick a partner, then roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-6: Two on two, and you lost. You and your partner drink 3. 7-12: Both twins cry in stereo. You and your partner give 2 each.

title: Psyduck
rules: Wild Psyduck has a headache. So do you. Hold your head and roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Confusion. Drink 6, and answer only in questions until your next turn. 2-5: Confusion. Drink 3, and answer only in questions until your next turn. 6-19: It waddles off, still confused. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! It waddles off, still confused. Give 4.

title: Machop
rules: Wild Machop wants to arm-wrestle. Flex for the table, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Karate Chop to the junk. Drink 6 and say "thank you, sensei." 2-5: Karate Chop to the junk. Drink 3 and say "thank you, sensei." 6-19: You flex harder. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You flex harder. Give 4.

title: Shinx
rules: Wild Shinx sparks when it sees you. Every hair on your body stands up. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Spark. Drink 3. 2-2: Shock. You and both neighbors drink 1. 3-3: You pet the spark out of it. Give 2. 4-4: It zaps your left neighbor instead. They drink 2. 5-5: Charge. It's still charging. Give 2. 6-6: It falls asleep in your lap. Give 3.

title: Roggenrola
rules: Wild Roggenrola is a rock with an ear. It heard what you said about it. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It tells everyone. Drink 4, and tell the table one thing you've said behind someone's back. 2-5: It tells everyone. Drink 2, and tell the table one thing you've said behind someone's back. 6-19: You skip it across a pond. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You skip it across a pond. Give 4.

title: Pikipek
rules: Wild Pikipek is drilling into a tree. Then your skull. Knock on the table, roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-5: Woodpecked. Drink 3. 6-12: It finds a better tree. Give 2.

title: Nickit
rules: Wild Nickit steals the drink nearest the drawer. Roll d20 to get it back.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It's gone. Finish whatever you have, then a fresh one. 2-5: It's gone. Finish whatever you have. 6-19: Recovered, with a tip. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! Recovered, with a tip. Give 6.

title: Swimmer Brad
rules: Swimmer Brad is in a Speedo on dry land and won't explain. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You looked. Drink 6 and describe what you saw. 2-5: You looked. Drink 3 and describe what you saw. 6-19: He goes back to the sea. Everyone in shorts drinks 2. 20-20: Natural 20! He goes back to the sea. Everyone in shorts drinks 4.

title: Juggler Rico
rules: Juggler Rico juggles three Voltorb. Juggle any two things for five seconds or drink 3.

title: Prepare for Trouble
rules: Jessie and James drop a net from a Meowth balloon. Recite what you can of their motto, then roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Netted. Drink 3. 2-2: Meowth scratches. Drink 2, and meow before every sip until your next turn. 3-3: Wobbuffet! Give 1. 4-4: They argue about the motto. Give 2. 5-5: They blast off again. Give 2. 6-6: They blast off again! Everyone points up; the last to point drinks 3.

title: The Recruiter
rules: The last guy on Nugget Bridge gives you a nugget, then asks you to join Team Rocket. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You signed something. Drink 8 and do the Rocket pose. 2-8: You signed something. Drink 4 and do the Rocket pose. 9-19: You keep the nugget and don't join. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You keep the nugget and don't join. Give 6.

title: Cooltrainer Ava
rules: Cooltrainer Ava has six fully evolved Pokémon on Route 3. Rude. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Her Gyarados sweeps. Drink 4. 2-2: Her Alakazam reads your mind. Drink 3 and read your last text aloud. 3-3: You sweep her back. Give 3. 4-4: She rage-quits. Give 3. 5-5: She asks for your number. Give 4. 6-6: She retires on the spot. Give 4.

title: Ponyta
rules: Wild Ponyta. A horse on fire. Gallop around your chair once, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Trampled. Drink 6, and gallop whenever you stand until your next turn. 2-6: Trampled. Drink 3, and gallop whenever you stand until your next turn. 7-19: You ride it into the sunset. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You ride it into the sunset. Give 6.

title: Sableye
rules: Wild Sableye stares at you with gem eyes from a cave. It's always staring. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It steals your soul. Drink 6 and sit in silence for 10 seconds. 2-6: It steals your soul. Drink 3 and sit in silence for 10 seconds. 7-19: You stare it down. The first player to look away from you drinks 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You stare it down. The first player to look away from you drinks 6.

title: Croagunk
rules: Wild Croagunk pokes you in the kidney and laughs. Poke your right neighbor, roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-5: Poison Jab. Drink 3. 6-12: You poke back harder. Give 3.

title: Sandile
rules: Wild Sandile is wearing sunglasses and doesn't care about you. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Sand in every crack. Drink 6 and squirm. 2-6: Sand in every crack. Drink 3 and squirm. 7-19: You steal the sunglasses. Wear them and give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You steal the sunglasses. Wear them and give 6.

title: Hawlucha
rules: Wild Hawlucha leaps off a tree and elbow-drops the table. Slam the table, roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Flying Press. Drink 4. 2-2: Body slam. Drink 2 while your left neighbor counts to three. 3-3: You kick out at two. Give 2. 4-4: You pin it for the three count. Give 3. 5-5: Tag team: pick a partner; you both give 2. 6-6: Off the top rope! Stand on your chair and give 4.

title: Mudbray
rules: Wild Mudbray is a donkey covered in mud and it wants to share. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Mud everywhere. Drink 6, and your right neighbor wipes your face. 2-6: Mud everywhere. Drink 3, and your right neighbor wipes your face. 7-19: You hose it off. The table points at the dirtiest mind here; they drink 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You hose it off. The table points at the dirtiest mind here; they drink 6.

title: Biker Gang
rules: A Biker on Cycling Road revs at you. Make the engine noise, roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He runs you over twice. Drink 3 and make the engine noise until your next turn. 2-6: Run over. Drink {total}. 7-19: He wipes out. Give 3 to whoever looks most like they own a motorcycle. 20-20: Natural 20! He wipes out. Give 6 to whoever looks most like they own a motorcycle.

title: Psychic Tyron
rules: Think of a number from 1 to 5. Psychic Tyron (your left neighbor) guesses it. Right: drink 3.

title: Snorlax Blocks the Way
rules: A Snorlax is asleep across the road. Play the Poké Flute (hum loudly) and roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: It rolls onto you. Drink 3. 2-2: It rolls onto you and your left neighbor. You both drink 2. 3-3: It snores and doesn't move. Drink 2 and hum louder. 4-4: It wakes up and wanders off. Give 2. 5-5: It wakes up hungry. Whoever has the most food nearby drinks 2. 6-6: It wakes up and rolls away. Give 3.

title: Slot Machine
rules: One more pull. You can feel it. Pull or walk?
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! The house wins. Drink 8. 2-10: The house wins. Drink 4. 11-19: Jackpot. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! Jackpot. Give 8.

title: Rocket Executive
rules: Behind the poster: a Rocket executive with a Raticate the size of a dog. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Hyper Fang to the shin. Drink 8 and hop. 2-9: Hyper Fang to the shin. Drink 4 and hop. 10-19: He drops the Silph Scope. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! He drops the Silph Scope. Give 8.

title: Gambler Lou
rules: Gambler Lou bets his whole stack on one battle. Push your drink to the middle, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You lose his money too. Drink 8. 2-9: You lose his money too. Drink 4. 10-19: You clean him out. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! He hands over his lucky coin too. Give 8.

title: Haunter
rules: Wild Haunter licks you. It's cold and it lingers. Lick your lips and roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Lick. Drink 6, and lick your lips before every sip until your next turn. 2-7: Lick. Drink 3, and lick your lips before every sip until your next turn. 8-19: It vanishes, giggling. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! It vanishes, giggling. Give 6.

title: Scyther
rules: Wild Scyther in the Safari Zone. It has knives for arms. Hold very still and roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Fury Cutter, three cuts. Drink 4. 2-2: Slash. Drink 3, and keep your hands flat on the table until your next turn. 3-3: Swords Dance, but it trips. Give 2. 4-4: You slip past its blades. Give 3. 5-5: It cuts your left neighbor's hair instead. They drink 3. 6-6: It bows and leaves. Give 4.

title: Tauros
rules: A herd of Tauros. Everyone at the table stomps. The drawer rolls d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Stampeded. Drink 8; the loudest stomper drinks with you. 2-7: Stampeded. Drink 4; the loudest stomper drinks with you. 8-19: You ride one out. Everyone yells yeehaw; the last one drinks 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You ride one out. Everyone yells yeehaw; the last one drinks 6.

title: Bronzor
rules: Wild Bronzor is a frying pan that floats. It hums. Hum back, then roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-6: It hums louder. Drink 3. 7-12: You use it as a frying pan. Give 3.

title: Mimikyu
rules: Wild Mimikyu is wearing a Pikachu costume and does not want you to look under it. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You looked. Drink 8, and don't tell anyone what you saw. 2-7: You looked. Drink 4, and don't tell anyone what you saw. 8-19: You leave its secret alone. Tell the table one of yours, then give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You leave its secret alone. Tell the table one of yours, then give 6.

title: Toxtricity
rules: Wild Toxtricity air-guitars at you. Air-guitar back for five seconds, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Booed off stage. Drink 6 and play one more riff. 2-7: Booed off stage. Drink 3 and play one more riff. 8-19: Encore! Pick a bandmate: they air-guitar for five seconds or drink 3. 20-20: Natural 20! Encore! Pick a bandmate: they air-guitar for five seconds or drink 6.

title: Beauty Cassandra
rules: Beauty Cassandra says you're not her type. Fight her about it. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You're not. Drink 6 and compliment your left neighbor. 2-7: You're not. Drink 3 and compliment your left neighbor. 8-19: She gives you her number. It's fake. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! She gives you her number. It's fake. Give 6.

title: Black Belt Kiyo
rules: Black Belt Kiyo wants twenty push-ups. Everyone counts. Fall short: drink 3.

title: Safari Zone
rules: Thirty Safari Balls and a rock. Toss a napkin at your left neighbor, then roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Everything runs. Drink 3. 2-2: You hit a Tauros with the rock. Drink 3. 3-3: Out of balls. Drink 2. 4-4: Something stays. Give 2. 5-5: A Kangaskhan, with baby. You and your left neighbor give 2 each. 6-6: A Dratini! Give 4.

title: Pokémon Tower
rules: The top floor is haunted by a ghost Marowak. Climb or leave?
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Get out... get out... Drink 8. 2-11: Get out... get out... Drink 4. 12-19: You put it to rest. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You put it to rest. Give 8.

title: Biker Boss
rules: The gang's boss has a Weezing and a prison tattoo. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Smog in the face. Drink 10; whoever sits closest to you coughs and drinks 2. 2-10: Smog in the face. Drink 5; whoever sits closest to you coughs and drinks 1. 11-19: He respects you now and buys a round. Everyone else drinks 2. 20-20: Natural 20! He respects you now and buys a round. Everyone else drinks 4.

title: Dragon Tamer
rules: A Dragon Tamer in a cape on a bike path. Her Dragonite is in a hurry. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Outrage. Drink 5. 2-2: Dragon Rush. Drink 4. 3-3: Thrash. Drink 3 and flail. 4-4: Tamed. Give 4. 5-5: The Dragonite gives you a lift. Give 4. 6-6: She hands you the cape. Give 5.

title: Gyarados
rules: You fished for a Magikarp and got its angry dad. Roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-6: Hyper Beam. Drink 4. 7-12: It's yours. Somehow. Give 3.

title: Lucario
rules: Wild Lucario reads your aura. It knows what you did. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Aura Sphere. Drink 8 and confess what you did. 2-7: Aura Sphere. Drink 4 and confess what you did. 8-19: Your aura wins. Pick a player: they confess something or drink 3. 20-20: Natural 20! Your aura wins. Pick a player: they confess something or drink 6.

title: Zoroark
rules: Wild Zoroark is disguised as someone here. Accuse a player, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Wrong person. You and the accused drink 6. 2-7: Wrong person. You and the accused drink 3. 8-19: Caught it. The accused drinks 3 and admits nothing. 20-20: Natural 20! Caught it. The accused drinks 6 and admits nothing.

title: Goodra
rules: Wild Goodra wants a hug. It is entirely slime. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Hugged. Drink 6 and hug your right neighbor. 2-7: Hugged. Drink 3 and hug your right neighbor. 8-19: You slip out. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You slip out. Give 6.

title: Tinkaton
rules: Wild Tinkaton has a hammer bigger than your car, and it wants your car. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Gigaton Hammer. Drink 5. 2-2: Totaled. Drink 3 and name your first car. 3-3: It hammers someone else's. Whoever drove here drinks 3. 4-4: It steals a bike instead. Give 3. 5-5: It hammers itself. Give 3. 6-6: You trade it your keys. Give 4.

title: Salandit
rules: Wild Salandit's gas is toxic and smells like your ex. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Toxic. Drink 6, and hold your nose for every sip until your next turn. 2-7: Toxic. Drink 3, and hold your nose for every sip until your next turn. 8-19: You hold your breath and walk. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You hold your breath and walk. Give 6.

title: Gentleman Alfred
rules: Gentleman Alfred challenges you to a battle with his Growlithe and his monocle. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Monocled. Drink 8 and speak posh until your next turn. 2-7: Monocled. Drink 4 and speak posh until your next turn. 8-19: He tips his hat. Give 3 in your poshest voice. 20-20: Natural 20! He tips his hat. Give 6 in your poshest voice.

title: Fisherman Ned
rules: Fisherman Ned tells a fish story. The drawer must top it, and the table votes. Lose: drink 4.

title: Silph Co. Maze
rules: Silph Co. Eleven floors of teleport pads. Spin in your chair twice, then roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Lost on floor 7. Drink 3. 2-2: Teleported into a meeting. Drink 2 and say "per my last email." 3-3: Back in the lobby. Drink 2 and swap seats with someone. 4-4: Found the card key. Give 2. 5-5: Found the president. Give 3. 6-6: Found the Master Ball. Give 4.

title: The Karate King
rules: The Karate King's Hitmonlee and Hitmonchan both want a piece of you. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Hitmonlee kicks. Drink 5. 2-2: Hitmonchan punches. Drink 4. 3-3: Both. Drink 3, and pick a partner who drinks 3. 4-4: You take Hitmonlee home. Give 4. 5-5: You take Hitmonchan home. Give 4. 6-6: You take both. Give 5.

title: Veteran Hugo
rules: Veteran Hugo fought in a war nobody mentions. He has a Salamence. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Flamethrower. Drink 10 and tell a war story. 2-10: Flamethrower. Drink 5 and tell a war story. 11-19: Hugo salutes you. Salute back and give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! Hugo salutes you. Salute back and give 8.

title: Angry Snorlax
rules: A Snorlax woke up on the wrong side of the road. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Body Slam. Drink 10, then lie on the floor for 10 seconds. 2-8: Body Slam. Drink 5, then lie on the floor for 10 seconds. 9-19: It goes back to sleep. Give 3, in a whisper. 20-20: Natural 20! It goes back to sleep. Give 6, in a whisper.

title: Gible's Dad
rules: You poked a Gible. Its dad, a Garchomp, appeared behind it. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Dragon Rush. Drink 4. 2-2: Earthquake. Everyone drinks 2. 3-3: You apologize to the family. Give 3. 4-4: Gible bites its dad. Give 3. 5-5: Sand Veil: it can't find you. Give 3. 6-6: It adopts you. Give 4.

title: Hydreigon
rules: Wild Hydreigon. Three heads, all hungry, none of them friendly. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! All three heads bite at once. Drink 6. 2-8: Bitten three times. Drink {total}. 9-19: The heads fight each other. Pick three players; they drink 1 each. 20-20: Natural 20! The heads fight each other. Pick three players; they drink 2 each.

title: Aegislash
rules: Wild Aegislash switches between sword and shield every time you swing. Roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-6: King's Shield. Drink 4. 7-12: You sheathe it. Give 3.

title: Dragapult
rules: Wild Dragapult fires its babies at you like missiles. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Direct hit. Drink 8 and duck. 2-8: Direct hit. Drink 4 and duck. 9-19: You catch a baby. Hand it to someone: they drink 3 and coo. 20-20: Natural 20! You catch a baby. Hand it to someone: they drink 6 and coo.

title: Kingambit
rules: Wild Kingambit demands you kneel. Kneel, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Sliced. Drink 8, and stay on your knees until your next turn. 2-8: Sliced. Drink 4, and stay on your knees until your next turn. 9-19: You rise. Everyone else kneels; the last one down drinks 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You rise. Everyone else kneels; the last one down drinks 6.

title: Ninja Boy
rules: A Ninja Boy jumps out of nowhere. Was he under the table? Check, then roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Shuriken. Drink 4. 2-2: Double Team. You and your left neighbor drink 2. 3-3: He vanishes in smoke. Give 3. 4-4: Substitute: he was a log. Give 3. 5-5: Caught him under the table. Give 4. 6-6: He was your left neighbor all along. They drink 4.

title: Sage Li
rules: Sage Li asks: what has keys but opens no locks? Answer in five seconds. Wrong: drink 4.

title: Seafoam Currents
rules: Seafoam Islands. Boulders, currents and a freezing cave. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Swept away. Drink 3. 2-2: Frozen cave. Drink 2, teeth chattering. 3-3: Boulder on your foot. Drink 2 and hop. 4-4: You Strength the boulder. Give 2. 5-5: You Surf the current. Give 3. 6-6: Articuno flies over. Everyone looks up; the last one drinks 3.

title: MissingNo.
rules: A glitch flickers on the shore. Your bag could fill up. Or your save could die.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Save corrupted. Drink 10. 2-12: Save corrupted. Drink 5. 13-19: Infinite items. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! Infinite items. Give 10.

title: Scientist Blaine Jr.
rules: Blaine's nephew made a Mewtwo in a jar. He wants to test it on you. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Psystrike. Drink 10, and your left neighbor reads your mind aloud. 2-11: Psystrike. Drink 5, and your left neighbor reads your mind aloud. 12-19: The jar breaks. Run! Everyone runs in place; the slowest drinks 3. 20-20: Natural 20! The jar breaks. Run! Everyone runs in place; the slowest drinks 6.

title: Burglar Sid
rules: Burglar Sid is robbing the mansion and you caught him. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He robs you too. Drink 10, and your right neighbor takes a sip of your drink. 2-11: He robs you too. Drink 5, and your right neighbor takes a sip of your drink. 12-19: He leaves the loot. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! He leaves the loot. Give 8.

title: Tyranitar
rules: Wild Tyranitar kicks up a sandstorm. Cover your drink and roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Stone Edge. Drink 10; anyone whose drink wasn't covered drinks 4. 2-8: Stone Edge. Drink 5; anyone whose drink wasn't covered drinks 2. 9-19: You weather the storm. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You weather the storm. Give 8.

title: Metagross
rules: Wild Metagross is four brains in a steel X. It already knows your roll. Roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-6: It knew. Drink 5. 7-12: It miscounted. Give 4.

title: Volcarona
rules: Wild Volcarona is a moth made of sun. Do a Quiver Dance and roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Fiery Dance. Drink 8 and keep dancing for 10 seconds. 2-8: Fiery Dance. Drink 4 and keep dancing for 10 seconds. 9-19: You out-dance it. Pick a player: they dance for 10 seconds or drink 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You out-dance it. Pick a player: they dance for 10 seconds or drink 8.

title: Kommo-o
rules: Wild Kommo-o rattles its scales like a metal concert. Headbang, then roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Clangorous Soul. Drink 5. 2-2: Mosh pit. You and both neighbors drink 2. 3-3: You crowd-surf away. Give 4. 4-4: Encore. Give 4. 5-5: You steal its guitar. Give 4. 6-6: It throws you a pick. Give 5.

title: Baxcalibur
rules: Wild Baxcalibur has a sword for a spine and it is very cold. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Glaive Rush. Drink 10, and drink only with your off hand until your next turn. 2-8: Glaive Rush. Drink 5, and drink only with your off hand until your next turn. 9-19: It shatters. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! It shatters. Give 8.

title: Gengar
rules: Wild Gengar is behind you. No, the other side. Turn around and roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Hypnosis. Drink 4 with your eyes shut. 2-2: Curse. You and whoever you turned toward drink 3. 3-3: It grins and fades. Give 4. 4-4: Shadow Ball misses. Give 4. 5-5: It haunts your left neighbor now. They drink 4. 6-6: It laughs so hard it vanishes. Give 5.

title: Cooltrainer Duo
rules: Two Cooltrainers with matching jackets and matching Dragonites. Pick a partner, roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-6: Double Outrage. You and your partner drink 4. 7-12: Their jackets are ruined. You and your partner give 2 each.

title: Pokémaniac Ed
rules: Pokémaniac Ed wants the drawer to name ten Pokémon in fifteen seconds. Miss: drink 4.

title: The Waterfall
rules: The only way up is Waterfall. Mime climbing one, then roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: You fall. Drink 4. 2-2: You fall onto a Magikarp. Drink 3. 3-3: Halfway, then down. Drink 2. 4-4: Wet, but you hang on. Drink 1. 5-5: You make it up. Give 2. 6-6: You are the waterfall. Start one to your left; you may stop first.

title: The Truck
rules: There's a truck by the S.S. Anne. Everyone knows Mew is under it. Strength it?
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Nothing there. You pulled a muscle. Drink 10. 2-13: Nothing there. You pulled a muscle. Drink 5. 14-19: Mew. Kind of. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! Mew. Kind of. Give 10.

title: Ace Trainer Rex
rules: Rex says he'd be Champion if he'd tried. He has a Garchomp. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He tried. Drink 10 and say "you could be Champion, Rex." 2-11: He tried. Drink 5 and say "you could be Champion, Rex." 12-19: Rex goes home to his mom. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! Rex goes home to his mom. Give 10.

title: Elite Four Reject
rules: An Elite Four member who got fired. Still bitter. Still good. Roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-7: Still good. Drink 5. 8-12: Still fired. Give 5.

title: Golurk
rules: A Golurk guards Victory Road: a robot made of clay and grudges. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Hammer Arm. Drink 5. 2-2: Heavy Slam. Drink 4. 3-3: It holds a grudge. Drink 3; your left neighbor says what for. 4-4: It crumbles. Give 4. 5-5: It lets you pass. Give 4. 6-6: It carries you up the road. Give 5.

title: Steelix
rules: A Steelix is the floor of the cave. You've been walking on it. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It wakes up. Drink 10, and whisper until your next turn. 2-9: It wakes up. Drink 5, and whisper until your next turn. 10-19: You tiptoe off it. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You tiptoe off it. Give 8.

title: Machamp
rules: Wild Machamp. Four arms, no shirt, very personal. Roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-6: Four punches at once. Drink 5. 7-12: You hug it into submission. Give 4.

title: Boulder Puzzle
rules: Victory Road's boulder puzzle. You pushed one wrong and now you're stuck. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Restart the puzzle. Drink 8 and swap seats with your left neighbor. 2-12: Restart the puzzle. Drink 4 and swap seats with your left neighbor. 13-19: Solved. Give 3, smugly. 20-20: Natural 20! Solved. Give 6, smugly.

title: Veteran Ada
rules: Veteran Ada wants to see your badges. The drawer names all eight from this run. Miss one: drink 4.

title: Ace Trainer Ilse
rules: Ace Trainer Ilse has six Pokémon and no mercy. Roll d6 for how many you beat.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: None. Drink 6. 2-2: One. Drink 5. 3-3: Two. Drink 4. 4-4: Three. Drink 3. 5-5: Five of six. Give 4. 6-6: All six. Give 6.

title: Ace Trainer Ben
rules: Ace Trainer Ben has been on Victory Road for nine years. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Nine years of practice. Drink 10, and tell the table what you'd do with nine years. 2-12: Nine years of practice. Drink 5, and tell the table what you'd do with nine years. 13-19: Ben finally goes home. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! Ben finally goes home. Give 10.

title: Blue
