rules: Smell ya later! Your rival shows up again with a full team and a haircut. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He smells ya. Drink 10 and sniff your own armpit. 2-8: He smells ya. Drink 5 and sniff your own armpit. 9-19: He cries to Grandpa. Give 4 and say "smell ya later." 20-20: Natural 20! He cries to Grandpa. Give 8 and say "smell ya later."

title: Silver
rules: Silver stole his starter and wants to steal yours. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Stolen. Drink 5. 2-2: He steals your seat. Drink 3 and swap seats with your left neighbor. 3-3: He learns to love his Pokémon. Give 4. 4-4: He calls you a wimp, then cries. Give 4. 5-5: He hands back your starter. Give 4. 6-6: He calls his dad. It's Giovanni. Give 5.

title: Wally
rules: Wally got healthy. Wally got strong. Wally has a Gallade. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Wally is so strong now. Drink 10 and cheer for him. 2-8: Wally is so strong now. Drink 5 and cheer for him. 9-19: Wally needs his inhaler. Everyone else takes a deep breath and drinks 2. 20-20: Natural 20! Wally needs his inhaler. Everyone else takes a deep breath and drinks 4.

title: Barry
rules: Barry runs into you and fines you ten million. Roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-6: Pay up. Drink 5. 7-12: He runs off to fine someone else. Pick who; they drink 4.

title: Hop
rules: Hop wants to beat you to impress his brother. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Leon claps for him. Drink 10 and strike the Charizard pose. 2-8: Leon claps for him. Drink 5 and strike the Charizard pose. 9-19: Hop needs a pep talk. Give him your best one, then give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! Hop needs a pep talk. Give him your best one, then give 8.

title: Nemona
rules: Nemona just wants to battle. Again. And again. She loves this. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! She wants a rematch now, and another. Drink 5 and high-five her twice. 2-8: She loves this. Drink {total}, and she wants a rematch. 9-19: She loves losing too. Give 4, then high-five everyone. 20-20: Natural 20! She loves losing too. Give 8, then high-five everyone.

title: Rocket Grunt
rules: A Rocket Grunt guards the basement under the Game Corner. He has a Zubat. Of course. Roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-6: Zubat. Of course. Drink 3. 7-12: He gives up the Lift Key. Give 3.

title: Slowpoke Tail Seller
rules: A Grunt is selling Slowpoke Tails. They're still twitching. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You bought one. Drink 6, slowly. 2-7: You bought one. Drink 3, slowly. 8-19: You free the Slowpoke. Give 3, very slowly. 20-20: Natural 20! You free the Slowpoke. Give 6, very slowly.

title: Spinner Tiles
rules: The hideout floor is spinner tiles. A Grunt laughs while you spin. Spin in your chair, roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Dizzy and beaten. Drink 6, then stand and walk a straight line. 2-7: Dizzy and beaten. Drink 3, then stand and walk a straight line. 8-19: You spin into him. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You spin into him. Give 6.

title: Giovanni
rules: Giovanni strokes his Persian and doesn't look up. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Persian's Slash. Drink 5. 2-2: Earthquake. Drink 4 and kiss his ring. 3-3: He looks up. Give 4. 4-4: Team Rocket disbands. For now. Give 4. 5-5: Persian switches sides. Give 4 and meow. 6-6: He says you remind him of his son. Give 5.

title: Magma Grunt
rules: A Magma Grunt in a red hood wants more land. Stand up and claim your chair. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He claims your chair. Drink 6, and stand until your next turn. 2-7: He claims your chair. Drink 3, and stand until your next turn. 8-19: Your land now. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! Your land now. Give 6.

title: Sweaty Grunt
rules: A Grunt inside a volcano in a full hoodie. He is so sweaty. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He hugs you. Drink 6 and fan yourself. 2-7: He hugs you. Drink 3 and fan yourself. 8-19: He passes out from heat. Everyone in a hoodie or jacket drinks 2. 20-20: Natural 20! He passes out from heat. Everyone in a hoodie or jacket drinks 4.

title: Tabitha
rules: Admin Tabitha laughs like a cartoon villain. Laugh back like one, then roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-6: His laugh wins. Drink 3. 7-12: Yours wins. Give 3.

title: Maxie
rules: Maxie pushes up his glasses and wakes Groudon. The room heats up. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Drought. Drink 10, and nobody refills your drink until your next turn. 2-7: Drought. Drink 5, and nobody refills your drink until your next turn. 8-19: Groudon goes back to sleep. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! Groudon goes back to sleep. Give 8.

title: Aqua Grunt
rules: An Aqua Grunt in a bandana wants more sea. Spit your drink back in the glass. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! More sea for him. Drink 6, and add a splash of water to your drink. 2-7: More sea for him. Drink 3, and add a splash of water to your drink. 8-19: You stay dry. Whoever's drink is fullest drinks 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You stay dry. Whoever's drink is fullest drinks 4.

title: Submarine Thief
rules: A Grunt is stealing a submarine. He asks you to look away. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: You looked away. Drink 3. 2-2: You helped him park it. Drink 3 and salute. 3-3: You sink his plan. Give 3. 4-4: You steal the sub. Give 3. 5-5: A Wailord rams it. Give 3. 6-6: He surfaces in the wrong ocean. Give 4.

title: Shelly
rules: Admin Shelly yawns at you. Everyone yawns. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Asleep. Drink 6 with your eyes shut. 2-7: Asleep. Drink 3 with your eyes shut. 8-19: Awake. The first player who yawned drinks 2. 20-20: Natural 20! Awake. The first player who yawned drinks 4.

title: Archie
rules: Archie rips his shirt open and wakes Kyogre. It starts raining indoors. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Drenched. Drink 10 and wring out your shirt. 2-7: Drenched. Drink 5 and wring out your shirt. 8-19: Kyogre goes back to sleep and Archie buttons his shirt. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! Kyogre goes back to sleep and Archie buttons his shirt. Give 8.

title: Galactic Grunt
rules: A Galactic Grunt with a bowl cut that's also a uniform. Roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-6: Bowl cut to the face. Drink 3. 7-12: You laugh at the haircut. Whoever had the worst haircut as a kid drinks 3.

title: Mars
rules: Commander Mars wants your Pokémon for science. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! For science. Drink 6, and the table names you like a lab rat until your next turn. 2-7: For science. Drink 3, and the table names you like a lab rat until your next turn. 8-19: Science denied. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! Science denied. Give 6.

title: Charon
rules: Charon the scientist cackles and points a ray gun at the drawer. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Zapped. Drink 3. 2-2: Shrink ray. Drink 2, and talk tiny until your next turn. 3-3: The gun was a hairdryer. Give 3. 4-4: It zaps his own foot. Give 3. 5-5: You take the gun. Give 3. 6-6: It zaps your left neighbor. They drink 3.

title: Cyrus
rules: Cyrus wants to erase all emotion. Everyone hold a straight face while the drawer rolls d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Feelings erased. Drink 10 without any expression. 2-7: Feelings erased. Drink 5 without any expression. 8-19: Cyrus learns to feel. The first player who smiled drinks 3. 20-20: Natural 20! Cyrus learns to feel. The first player who smiled drinks 6.

title: Plasma Grunt
rules: A Plasma Grunt dressed as a knight tells you to free your Pokémon. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Freed and beaten. Drink 6, and your left neighbor sips your drink. 2-7: Freed and beaten. Drink 3, and your left neighbor sips your drink. 8-19: You keep them. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You keep them. Give 6.

title: Sage
rules: One of the Seven Sages lectures you about Pokémon liberation. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Lectured. Drink 6, then lecture the table for five seconds. 2-7: Lectured. Drink 3, then lecture the table for five seconds. 8-19: You walk out. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You walk out. Give 6.

title: N
rules: N talks very fast about truth and ideals. Your left neighbor does N for five seconds; you roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-6: You can't keep up. Drink 3. 7-12: N spins away on a Ferris wheel. Give 3.

title: Ghetsis
rules: Ghetsis, in a cape with eyes on it, calls you a worthless trash. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Worthless. Drink 10 and call yourself trash. 2-7: Worthless. Drink 5 and call yourself trash. 8-19: His cape rips. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! His cape rips. Give 8.

title: Flare Grunt
rules: A Flare Grunt in a red suit says your outfit is ugly. Defend your outfit and roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It's ugly. Drink 6, and the table rates your outfit out of 10. 2-7: It's ugly. Drink 3, and the table rates your outfit out of 10. 8-19: Fashion wins. The table points at the worst-dressed player; they drink 3. 20-20: Natural 20! Fashion wins. The table points at the worst-dressed player; they drink 6.

title: Flare Scientist
rules: A Flare scientist in orange goggles shows you a doomsday weapon. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: It works. Drink 3. 2-2: It's a laser pointer, aimed at your eye. Drink 3. 3-3: It's a toaster. Give 3. 4-4: It's a hair straightener. Give 3. 5-5: It explodes in his hand. Give 3. 6-6: It's a disco ball. Everyone dances; the stiffest drinks 3.

title: Flare Admin
rules: A Flare admin charges five million to join. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You paid. Drink 6 and compliment everyone's outfit. 2-7: You paid. Drink 3 and compliment everyone's outfit. 8-19: You talk her down. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You talk her down. Give 6.

title: Lysandre
rules: Lysandre's hair is on fire, figuratively. He wants a beautiful world. Roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-6: Beautiful. Drink 5. 7-12: The ultimate weapon misfires. Give 4.

title: Skull Grunt
rules: A Skull Grunt does the Skull pose and says YO. Everyone does the pose. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! YO. Drink 6, and say YO before every sip until your next turn. 2-7: YO. Drink 3, and say YO before every sip until your next turn. 8-19: No YO. The table picks the worst pose; that player drinks 2. 20-20: Natural 20! No YO. The table picks the worst pose; that player drinks 4.

title: Rapping Grunt
rules: A Skull Grunt raps at you badly. Rap back four lines, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! His bars were better. Drink 6. 2-7: His bars were better. Drink 3. 8-19: No bars. Give 3, in rhyme. 20-20: Natural 20! No bars. Give 6, in rhyme.

title: Plumeria
rules: Big sis Plumeria wants to know why you hurt her boys. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: She hurts you. Drink 3. 2-2: She calls your mom. Drink 3 and apologize. 3-3: She respects you. Give 3. 4-4: She lets her boys go home. Give 3. 5-5: She buys you a drink. Give 4. 6-6: She joins your side. Give 4.

title: Guzma
rules: Guzma is the hated boss who beats you down. He says so himself. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Beaten down. Drink 10, and shout "Guzma!" like he does. 2-7: Beaten down. Drink 5, and shout "Guzma!" like he does. 8-19: Guzma, what is you doing? Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! Guzma, what is you doing? Give 8.

title: Oleana
rules: Oleana, Chairman Rose's secretary, has a meeting with you. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! The meeting ran long. Drink 6 and summarize it for the table. 2-7: The meeting ran long. Drink 3 and summarize it for the table. 8-19: Meeting cancelled. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! Meeting cancelled. Give 6.

title: Macro Intern
rules: An intern asks you to fill out a feedback survey before battling. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Twenty questions. Drink 3. 2-2: Mandatory feedback. Drink 2 and name one thing the table could do better. 3-3: You lie on the survey. Give 3. 4-4: You give it five stars. Give 3. 5-5: You fill it out for him. Give 3. 6-6: He quits. Give 4.

title: Tower Security
rules: Tower Security wants your badge. Not that badge, your ID badge. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You don't have one. Drink 6 and say your full name. 2-7: You don't have one. Drink 3 and say your full name. 8-19: You walk right past. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You walk right past. Give 6.

title: Chairman Rose
rules: Chairman Rose woke Eternatus to fix the energy crisis a thousand years early. Roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-6: Darkest Day. Drink 5 with your eyes shut. 7-12: The lights stay on. Give 4.

title: Star Grunt
rules: A Team Star grunt does the Star Shuffle. Do it with her, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Starstruck. Drink 6, and keep shuffling until your next turn. 2-7: Starstruck. Drink 3, and keep shuffling until your next turn. 8-19: You shuffle past. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You shuffle past. Give 6.

title: Starmobile
rules: A boss revs a Starmobile, a car made of Revavroom. Rev with your mouth, roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-6: Run over. Drink 3. 7-12: It stalls. Give 3.

title: Star Squad
rules: Thirty grunts. Thirty seconds. Everyone points at the drawer. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Thirty grunts sit on you. Drink 4, and everyone who pointed points again. 2-7: Overrun. Drink {total}. 8-19: Thirty down. Everyone who pointed drinks 1. 20-20: Natural 20! Thirty down. Everyone who pointed drinks 2.

title: Cassiopeia
rules: Cassiopeia was the Champion's classmate all along. Plot twist. Roll d6.
dice: 1d6 — 1-1: Twist. Drink 5. 2-2: Double twist: she's also your left neighbor. You both drink 3. 3-3: Team Star disbands. Give 4. 4-4: She hands over the Star Badge. Give 4. 5-5: Everyone makes up. Give 4. 6-6: She cries. Give 5.

title: Lickitung
rules: Lickitung used Lick! Give 2 and keep your tongue out until your next turn.

title: Team Magma
rules: Team Magma recruited you! If you're on Team Magma, make a rule for the rest of the game. Otherwise, drink 7.

title: Team Aqua
rules: Team Aqua recruited you! If you're on Team Aqua, make a rule for the rest of the game. Otherwise, drink 7.

title: Pineco
rules: Pineco used Protect! Drink 2. Until your next turn, ignore every drink given to you.

title: Farfetch'd
rules: Farfetch'd got away! Drink 1. For the rest of the game, fetch drinks for anyone who asks.

title: Raticate
rules: Raticate used Pursuit! For the rest of the game, drink 1 whenever you leave the table.

title: Mankey
rules: Mankey used Swagger! Teach a handshake. Until your next turn, fumbles drink 1.

title: Aipom
rules: Aipom used Baton Pass! Until your next turn, pass every drink you're given to another player.

title: Skarmory
rules: Steel Wing! Drink 3. Until your next turn, drinks given to you bounce to the player on your right.

title: Tropius
rules: Tropius used Sweet Scent! Until your next turn, every drink given out comes to you instead.

title: Sandshrew
rules: Sandshrew used Sand-Attack! Drink with your non-dominant hand for the rest of the game.

title: Vulpix
rules: Vulpix used Will-O-Wisp! For the rest of the game, add 1 to every drink you take.

title: Shuppet
rules: Shuppet used Curse! For the rest of the game, drink 1 every time you curse.

title: Ditto
rules: Ditto used Transform! Until your next turn, copy everything the next player does.

title: Psyduck
rules: Psyduck has a headache! Until your next turn, hold your head. Let go and drink 1.

title: Lapras
rules: Lapras used Confuse Ray! Pick a player. Until your next turn, they speak in questions or drink 1.

title: Egg
rules: You got an Egg! Hold an object until your next turn. Caught without it: drink 1.

title: Togepi
rules: Togepi hatched! Make a new rule for the rest of the game. Violations: drink 1.

title: Eevee
rules: Eeveelution time! Choose a new rule for the rest of the game. Violations: drink 1.

title: Trick House
rules: The Trick House! Make a tricky new rule for the rest of the game. Violations: drink 1.

title: Pokémon Tower
rules: Out of respect for the dead: no talking until your next turn. Slip and drink 1.

title: Murkrow
rules: Murkrow used Mimic! Pick a player and repeat everything they say until your next turn.

title: Barboach
rules: Barboach used Mud-slap! Name a player. For the rest of the game, they may slap you once after a full drink.

title: Mawile
rules: Mawile used Vicegrip! Until your next turn, grab a player and squeeze them. Drink 4 and apologize.

title: Relicanth
rules: Relicanth used Dive! Kneel under the table until your next turn. Surface early: drink 2.

title: Bulbasaur
rules: Bulbasaur chose you. Two less HP, but every heal heals one more. Everyone sniff the bulb.

title: Charmander
rules: Charmander chose you. Wild fights hurt one less, bosses one more. Keep its tail lit.

title: Squirtle
rules: Squirtle chose you, in sunglasses. A Protect to start, but the bag holds only two.

title: Pikachu
rules: Pikachu won't go in its ball and won't evolve. Ever. Two more HP and an X Attack. Everyone yells Pika.

title: Eevee
rules: Eevee chose you. Two less HP, a bag of four, and the table picks what it evolves into.

title: Cyndaquil
rules: Cyndaquil chose you, half asleep. One less HP, but an X Attack to start.

title: Totodile
rules: Totodile chose you by biting you. Three more HP, but wild fights hurt one more.

title: Treecko
rules: Treecko chose you. An Escape Rope to start; rivals and Ace Trainers hurt one more.

title: Torchic
rules: Torchic chose you. Two less HP, but rivals and Ace Trainers hurt one less. Everyone flap and peep.

title: Mudkip
rules: So I herd u liek Mudkipz. Four less HP, but bosses hurt one less.

title: Piplup
rules: Piplup chose you and is very proud of it. Six more HP and a Protect, but every boss takes a hit more.

title: Turtwig
rules: Turtwig chose you, slowly. Four more HP, but the bag holds only two.

title: Oshawott
rules: Oshawott chose you, scalchop out. Three less HP, but a Protect and an X Attack to start.

title: Froakie
rules: Froakie chose you, covered in bubbles. Two less HP, but two Escape Ropes to start.

title: Rowlet
rules: Rowlet chose you and fell asleep on your head. One less HP, but hazards and finds hurt one less.

title: Scorbunny
rules: Scorbunny chose you, bouncing. Wild fights and trainers hurt one less, but the bag holds two.

title: Fuecoco
rules: Fuecoco chose you because you had snacks. Three less HP, but every heal heals two more.

title: Staring Contest
rules: Start the clock and stare down your left neighbor. First to look away or laugh drinks 3.
dice: Clock 30 s: Time. Nobody broke? You both drink 2.

title: Straight Face
rules: Start the clock. Everyone tries to make you laugh; keep a straight face the whole time.
dice: Clock 30 s: Time. Cracked? Drink 3. Held it? Everyone else drinks 2.

title: Plank It
rules: Start the clock and hold a plank until time's up. Drop early and you drink 4.
dice: Clock 30 s: Time. Still up? Give 4.

title: Backwards
rules: Start the clock and say the alphabet backwards, Z to A, before time runs out.
dice: Clock 20 s: Time. Made it to A? Give 3. Didn't? Drink 3.

title: Wall Sit
rules: Start the clock and wall sit until time's up. Stand early and you drink 4.
dice: Clock 30 s: Time. Still sitting? Give 4.

title: No Blinking
rules: Start the clock and don't blink until time's up. Your left neighbor watches.
dice: Clock 15 s: Time. Blinked? Drink 3. Didn't? Give 3.

title: Tongue Twister
rules: Start the clock and say "red lorry, yellow lorry" five times before time runs out.
dice: Clock 10 s: Time. Tripped up or ran out? Drink 3. Nailed it? Give 3.

title: Secret Rule
rules: Read alone. This rule holds the rest of the game; anyone you catch breaking it drinks 2.
dice: Secret: Nobody may say the word "drink."

rules: Read alone. This rule holds the rest of the game; anyone you catch breaking it drinks 2.
dice: Secret: Nobody may point with a finger.

title: Secret Rule
rules: Read alone. This rule holds the rest of the game; anyone you catch breaking it drinks 2.
dice: Secret: Nobody may say anyone's name.

title: Lost and Found
rules: Everything anyone lost down here, plus a coaster that looks bulletproof. Drink 1.

title: The Tip Jar
rules: A tip jar lost under the shelves since 2011. A loaded die rattles in the coins. Drink 1.

title: Rat Fence
rules: A rat in a tiny vest is selling whatever fell behind the bar. He takes drinks, or blood.

title: Cellar Master's Coat
rules: A coat on a hook with full pockets: a corkscrew and a smoke bomb. Drink 1.

title: The Magnum
rules: A magnum of something nice behind the racks. Everyone gets a splash; save a swig. Drink 1.

title: The Cellar Cat
rules: A cat in a sommelier's chain trades mouse-bitten goods. It takes drinks, or blood.

title: The Bone Pile
rules: Under the bones: a smoke bomb and a stranger's fake ID. Keep both. Drink 1.

title: The Grave Robber
rules: A grave robber with a cart of stolen goods and no questions asked. Prices are firm.

title: Flushed Purse
rules: A purse dropped down a toilet, somehow dry: lipstick, a lighter, a smoke bomb. Drink 1.

title: Maintenance Locker
rules: A hard hat and a thermos of something brown. Wear one, drink from the other. Drink 1.

title: The Mole Man
rules: A man who lives down here sells whatever washes past. He takes drinks, or blood.

title: Message in a Bottle
rules: It says drink me. Of course it does. Drink 1, and keep the bottle.

title: The Pearl Diver
rules: A diver in a rusted helmet trades whatever he finds at the bottom of the bar.

title: Staff Meal
rules: Fries, pickles, and a shot the cooks hid for you. Drink 1, and pocket a smoke bomb.

title: Knife Roll
rules: A chef's knife roll left on the pass, something heavy in the end pocket. Drink 1.

title: The Dishwasher
rules: The dishwasher has seen everything, and he'll sell you some of it, for drinks or blood.

title: Wishing Drain
rules: A floor drain full of coins and one fry. Toss something in. Everyone toasts the drain.

title: Two Hatches
rules: Two hatches in the floor. One is quiet. The other is playing Nickelback, loud, on purpose.

title: The Tasting Room
rules: Cheese, crackers, and one clean glass. Everyone toasts the cheese.

title: Red or White
rules: Two aisles. White is quiet. Red is where the screaming is coming from.

title: Candlelit Alcove
rules: Someone left candles and a case of water down here. Everyone drinks water. Yes, really.

title: The Split
rules: The tunnel splits. Left: silence. Right: drums, chanting, and what might be a conga line.

title: Storm Drain Skylight
rules: A grate overhead and real moonlight. Everyone looks up and makes a wish.

title: Two Pipes
rules: Two pipes, big enough to crawl. One drips. The other gurgles, and it sounds like laughing.

title: The Air Pocket
rules: A pocket of air and a jukebox that still works. Everyone sings a chorus, any chorus.

title: The Last Dry Booth
rules: One booth the water never reached. Sit. Breathe. Everyone toasts dry socks.

title: Two Taps
rules: Two taps behind the bar. One pours water. The other pours something that screams.

title: The Break Room
rules: A couch, a microwave, and twelve minutes of peace. Everyone sits down and sips.

title: The Pass
rules: Two ways out: the quiet back door, or straight through the line in the dinner rush.

title: Gelatinous Shot
rules: A wobbling cube of jello shots. Something's floating in it. A tooth? Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It engulfs you. Drink 6. 2-5: It engulfs you. Drink 3. 6-19: You eat your way out. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You eat the whole thing. Give 6.

title: Rats in a Coat
rules: Nine rats in a trench coat are trying to order a drink. Card them. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! They swarm your ankles. Drink 6. 2-5: They swarm your ankles. Drink 3. 6-19: Bounced. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! Bounced. Give 6.

title: Mold Elemental
rules: The thing growing behind the ice machine has feelings and a mouth. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It moves into your lungs. Drink 5. 2-5: You breathe it in. Drink 3. 6-19: Bleach. So much bleach. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! Bleach. So much bleach. Give 6.

title: Drunk Goblin
rules: A goblin who's had nine. He wants to fight you, then hug you. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He wins both. Drink 6. 2-5: He wins both. Drink 3. 6-19: He passes out on you. Loot his pockets. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! He passes out on you. Loot his pockets. Give 4.

title: Skeleton Barback
rules: He's been restocking limes since 1974. Ask for a fresh one and roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He throws one at your eye. Drink 6. 2-5: He throws one at your eye. Drink 3. 6-19: He finds one. It's perfect. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! He finds one. It's perfect. Give 6.

title: Possessed Mop
rules: The mop is moving on its own and it's coming for your shoes. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Mopped. Drink 6. 2-5: Mopped. Drink 3. 6-19: You snap the handle. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You snap the handle. Give 6.

title: Keg Spider
rules: Eight legs, eight beers, zero manners. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Bitten. Drink 6. 2-5: Bitten. Drink 3. 6-19: Squished. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! Squished, and its web was full of coasters. Give 5.

title: Tab Goblin
rules: It's been putting drinks on your tab since 2019. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It collects. Drink 8. 2-5: It collects. Drink 4. 6-19: You stiff it. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You stiff it. Give 6.

title: Clipboard Troll
rules: You're not on the list. Walk heel to toe across the room and back. Wobble: drink 3.

title: The Riddling Tap
rules: A tap with a face. Your left neighbor asks a riddle: 10 seconds, or drink 3.

title: The Stuck Door
rules: Brace it shut with your back: wall-sit for 30 seconds. Stand early: drink 3.

title: Sticky Floor
rules: Your shoes are glued to forty years of spilled lager. Roll d20 to pull free.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You leave a shoe behind. Drink 4. 2-7: You leave a shoe behind. Drink 2. 8-19: You peel free. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You peel free. Give 4.

title: Tripwire
rules: Someone strung Christmas lights across the stairs at shin height. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You eat the stairs. Drink 4. 2-7: You eat the stairs. Drink 2. 8-19: You hop it. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You hop it. Give 4.

title: Rolling Kegs
rules: The keg rack groans. Then it lets go. Roll d20 to dive.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Flattened. Drink 6. 2-7: Flattened. Drink 3. 8-19: You dive clear. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You dive clear. Give 4.

title: Lost Bridesmaids
rules: Two bridesmaids looking for the bathroom found you instead. They want a photo. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You're in forty photos. Drink 4. 2-5: You're in forty photos. Drink 2. 6-19: You point them upstairs. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You point them upstairs. Give 4.

title: Grease Trap Horror
rules: The grease trap has been fed fries for twenty years. Now it's hungry. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It slurps you in. Drink 8. 2-8: It slurps you in. Drink 4. 9-19: You seal the lid. Inside: a pizza pan that makes a fine shield. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You seal the lid. Inside: a pizza pan that makes a fine shield. Give 8.

title: The Health Inspector
rules: Clipboard, hairnet, no soul. He's here to shut the cellar down. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Violation. Drink 8. 2-8: Violation. Drink 4. 9-19: You bribe him with a keg. He leaves his lucky die. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You bribe him with a keg. He leaves his lucky die. Give 8.

title: Keg Golem
rules: It's 800 pounds of lager and it's been tapped. Everyone drinks 1, then you roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It sits on you. Drink 8. 2-7: It sits on you. Drink 4. 8-19: You pull its plug. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You drink it dry. Everyone else drinks 3.

title: The Rat King
rules: Forty rats in one crown, holding court in the grease trap. Bow, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! The court finds you delicious. Finish your drink. 2-7: The court finds you guilty. Drink 4. 8-19: You dethrone him. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You dethrone him. Give 10.

title: The Landlord
rules: He wants three months' rent and he's taking it out of your drink. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Evicted. Finish your drink. 2-7: Late fee. Drink 4. 8-19: You find a code violation. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You find a code violation. Give 10.

title: Boxed Wine Golem
rules: A golem made of boxed wine, slapping its own bag. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It slaps you with the bag. Drink 6. 2-5: It slaps you with the bag. Drink 3. 6-19: You pop the spout. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You drink the bag dry. Give 6.

title: Cork Imp
rules: A tiny imp popping corks at eye level and laughing about it. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Right in the eye. Drink 6. 2-5: Right in the eye. Drink 3. 6-19: You cork him. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You cork him. Give 6.

title: Zombie Sommelier
rules: Brains? No. He wants to describe the finish. It takes eleven minutes. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Notes of oak. Drink 6. 2-5: Notes of oak. Drink 3. 6-19: You spit in his bucket. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You spit in his bucket. Give 6.

title: Wine Mom Banshee
rules: She screams that it's five o'clock somewhere, and she means here. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! She adopts you. Drink 5. 2-5: It's five o'clock. Drink 3. 6-19: You take her glass away. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You take her glass away. Give 6.

title: Rosé Slime
rules: Pink, sticky, and it says it's not like other slimes. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It's exactly like other slimes. Drink 6. 2-5: It's exactly like other slimes. Drink 3. 6-19: You pop it. It leaves pink smoke behind. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You pop it. It leaves pink smoke behind. Give 4.

title: Ghost in the Decanter
rules: It's been breathing for a hundred years. So has the wine. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It breathes on you. Drink 6. 2-5: It breathes on you. Drink 3. 6-19: You jam the stopper in. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You jam the stopper in. Give 6.

title: Barrel Mimic
rules: Barrel 14 has teeth. Barrel 15 looks nervous. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Barrel 14 wins. Drink 8. 2-5: Barrel 14 wins. Drink 4. 6-19: You tap it. It whimpers. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You tap it. It whimpers. Give 6.

title: Corkscrew Crab
rules: A crab with corkscrews for claws, opening anything. Including you. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Uncorked. Drink 6. 2-5: Uncorked. Drink 3. 6-19: You flip it on its back. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You open a bottle with it. Give 5.

title: Fruit Fly Swarm
rules: A cloud of fruit flies off the dump bucket, and they brought friends. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! In your mouth. Drink 4. 2-5: In your mouth. Drink 2. 6-19: Swatted. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! Swatted. Give 4.

title: Blind Tasting
rules: Eyes shut. Your left neighbor hands you someone's drink. Name whose it is. Wrong: drink 3.

title: Coaster on the Nose
rules: Balance a coaster on your nose for 10 seconds. It falls: drink 3.

title: Swirl, Sniff, Lie
rules: Describe your drink like a sommelier for 15 seconds without laughing. Laugh: drink 3.

title: Falling Rack
rules: The wine rack tips, one bottle at a time, like dominoes. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Domino'd. Drink 6. 2-7: Domino'd. Drink 3. 8-19: You catch the last one. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You catch the last one. Give 4.

title: Merlot Stairs
rules: The stairs are slick with spilled merlot. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Down on your ass, in red. Drink 4. 2-7: Down on your ass, in red. Drink 2. 8-19: Not a drop on you. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! Not a drop on you. Give 4.

title: Sulfite Cloud
rules: A cracked cask puffs out a cloud of sulfites. Instant headache. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Migraine. Drink 4. 2-7: Migraine. Drink 2. 8-19: You duck under it. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You duck under it. Give 4.

title: The Wine Snob
rules: He swirls, he sniffs, he says you'd like something approachable. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Approachable. Drink 8. 2-8: Approachable. Drink 4. 9-19: You pour his '82 into a Solo cup. He drops a loaded die. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You pour his '82 into a Solo cup. He drops a loaded die. Give 8.

title: Grape Elemental
rules: Two tons of grapes, stomped into rage. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Stomped. Drink 8. 2-8: Stomped. Drink 4. 9-19: Raisin. It leaves a draught behind. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! Raisin. It leaves a draught behind. Give 8.

title: Count Corkula
rules: He does not drink... blood. He drinks pinot. Yours. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He drains your glass. Drink 8. 2-7: He drains your glass. Drink 4. 8-19: A stake through the cork. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! Sunlight. Everyone else drinks 3.

title: The Cask Queen
rules: She sits on a throne of barrels and judges your palate. Curtsy, then roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Off with your glass. Finish your drink. 2-7: Your palate is basic. Drink 4. 8-19: You knock out a barrel. She tumbles. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You knock out a barrel. She tumbles. Give 10.

title: Château Ghoul
rules: A ghoul in a beret who thinks your wine is beneath you. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He sneers you to death. Drink 8. 2-7: He sneers you to death. Drink 4. 8-19: You hand him a White Claw. He dissolves. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You hand him a White Claw. He dissolves. Give 10.

title: Bachelor Ghosts
rules: The ghosts of a 1998 bachelor party want one more round. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You're in the round. Drink 8. 2-7: You're in the round. Drink 4. 8-19: You exorcise them with karaoke. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You exorcise them with karaoke. Give 8.

title: The Ex Wraith
rules: A wraith with your ex's face reads your old texts aloud, with feeling. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It reads the drafts. Finish your drink. 2-7: Every word lands. Drink 4. 8-19: You read theirs back. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You read theirs back. Give 8.

title: Bone Sommelier
rules: A skeleton swirls a glass, sniffs yours, and calls it cute. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Shamed. Drink 8. 2-7: Shamed. Drink 4. 8-19: You pour his on the floor. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You pour his on the floor. Give 8.

title: Leech Swarm
rules: Leeches that drink blood and, apparently, Fireball. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! They latch on and won't let go. Drink 6. 2-7: They latch on and won't let go. Drink 3. 8-19: You salt them. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You salt them. Give 8.

title: Hex Witch
rules: A witch who reads tarot and your browser history. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Hexed. Drink 6. 2-7: Hexed. Drink 3. 8-19: You flip her table. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You flip her table. Give 8.

title: Vampire Bro
rules: A vampire in a backwards cap who only drinks from frat boys. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He makes an exception. Drink 8. 2-7: He makes an exception. Drink 4. 8-19: Garlic knots to the face. He drops something. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! Garlic knots to the face. He drops something. Give 6.

title: Crypt Crawler
rules: Something with a hundred legs and one beer gut. Roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-6: It crawls up your shirt. Drink 4. 7-12: You stomp it flat. Give 4.

title: Hungover Mummy
rules: A mummy wrapped in bar napkins, hungover for three thousand years. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It throws up sand on you. Drink 8. 2-7: It throws up sand on you. Drink 4. 8-19: You hand it a Gatorade. It weeps. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You hand it a Gatorade. It weeps. Give 8.

title: Tomb of Silence
rules: No laughing in the tomb. The table gets 30 seconds to crack you. Laugh: drink 4.

title: The Bone Tower
rules: Stack the empties into a tower that stands for 5 seconds. Collapse: drink 4.

title: Backwards Chant
rules: Wake the dead: say the alphabet from Z to A in 20 seconds. Stumble: drink 4.

title: Collapsing Floor
rules: The floor gives way under you. Roll d20 to grab the edge.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You fall a whole floor. Drink 6. 2-9: You fall a whole floor. Drink 3. 10-19: You hang on. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You hang on. Give 4.

title: Dart Wall
rules: Little holes in both walls. Then a click. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Darted, in the ass. Drink 6. 2-9: Darted, in the ass. Drink 3. 10-19: You limbo under them. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You limbo under them. Give 4.

title: Fog of Regret
rules: A green fog that smells like the tequila from your 21st. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Flashbacks. Drink 6. 2-9: Flashbacks. Drink 3. 10-19: You hold your breath. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You hold your breath. Give 4.

title: Skeleton Crew
rules: A skeleton bachelorette party wants you to do a shot off a femur. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Off the femur. Drink 6. 2-7: Off the femur. Drink 3. 8-19: You knock their bones loose. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You knock their bones loose. Give 6.

title: The Crypt Keeper's Mom
rules: She's been waiting up. Do you know what time it is? Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Grounded, in a tomb. Drink 10. 2-10: Grounded, in a tomb. Drink 5. 11-19: You hug her. She packs you a draught for the road. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You hug her. She packs you a draught for the road. Give 10.

title: Death's Intern
rules: Death's unpaid intern is behind on quota, and you'll do. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Filed. Drink 10. 2-10: Filed. Drink 5. 11-19: You fill out his forms wrong. He drops a smoke bomb and runs. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You fill out his forms wrong. He drops a smoke bomb and runs. Give 10.

title: Hangover Hydra
rules: Every head you cut off grows back with a headache. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It breathes regret. Drink 10. 2-9: It breathes regret. Drink 5. 10-19: A head comes off. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! Clean through the neck. Everyone else drinks 3.

title: The Bouncer
rules: Seven feet of door guy in a tight black tee. Nobody gets past him. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He throws you out. Finish your drink. 2-9: He throws you down the stairs. Drink 5. 10-19: You get past one arm. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You get past one arm. Give 8.

title: DJ Ossuary
rules: A skeleton DJ who only plays the Macarena. Everyone does the Macarena, then you roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He drops the bass on you. Drink 10. 2-9: He drops the bass on you. Drink 5. 10-19: You yank a cable. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You steal the aux. Everyone else drinks 3.

title: Gator Junior
rules: Someone flushed a baby gator in 1995. He is not a baby. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Chomp. Drink 8. 2-7: Chomp. Drink 4. 8-19: You give him a belly rub. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You give him a belly rub. Give 8.

title: Toilet Mimic
rules: The only toilet down here is licking its lips. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! The full swirlie. Finish your drink. 2-7: Swirlie. Drink 4. 8-19: You flush it. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You flush it. Give 8.

title: Hazmat Goblin
rules: A goblin in a hazmat suit who loves it down here. Loves it. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He hugs you. Drink 8. 2-7: He hugs you. Drink 4. 8-19: You pull his air hose. He drops a smoke bomb. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You pull his air hose. He drops a smoke bomb. Give 6.

title: Sludge Bro
rules: A pile of sludge in a muscle shirt asks if you even lift. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You don't. Drink 8. 2-7: You don't. Drink 4. 8-19: You lift him, into the drain. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You lift him, into the drain. Give 8.

title: Pizza Rat Prime
rules: The original pizza rat, nine feet tall now and still dragging the slice. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Slice to the face. Drink 8. 2-7: Slice to the face. Drink 4. 8-19: You take the slice. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You take the slice and eat it. Give 6.

title: The Drain Witch
rules: She brews in the runoff, and she's offering you a sip. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You sip. Drink 6. 2-7: You sip. Drink 3. 8-19: You pour it back. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You pour it back. Give 8.

title: Fatberg Spawn
rules: A baby fatberg made of wet wipes and grease. It wants its mom. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It clings. Drink 6. 2-7: It clings. Drink 3. 8-19: You flush it. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You flush it. Give 8.

title: Sewer Mutant
rules: A mutant with three arms and a fourth beer wants to arm-wrestle. Roll 2d6.
dice: 2d6 — 2-6: It has three arms. Drink 4. 7-12: You win, somehow. Give 4.

title: Roach Conga
rules: The roaches are doing a conga line, and now you're in it. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You conga'd. Drink 6. 2-7: You conga'd. Drink 3. 8-19: You break the line. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You break the line. Give 6.

title: The Smell
rules: Hold your nose and talk normally about your day for 30 seconds. Let go: drink 4.

title: The Pipe
rules: Crawl under the table and out the other side without touching a leg. Touch one: drink 4.

title: The Echo
rules: Talk for 30 seconds while everyone repeats your last word back at you. Stop: drink 4.

title: The Big Flush
rules: Somewhere above, a whole bar flushes at once. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Swept down the pipe. Drink 6. 2-9: Swept down the pipe. Drink 3. 10-19: You grab a ladder. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You grab a ladder. Give 4.

title: Loose Grate
rules: The grate under your foot isn't attached to anything. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! One leg down a drain. Drink 6. 2-9: One leg down a drain. Drink 3. 10-19: You hop off. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You hop off. Give 4.

title: Swamp Gas
rules: Somebody lit a cigarette. Down here. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Eyebrows gone. Drink 6. 2-9: Eyebrows gone. Drink 3. 10-19: You dive into the sludge. Give 2. 20-20: Natural 20! You dive into the sludge. Give 4.

title: Clog Beast
rules: Everything anyone ever flushed, fused into one angry clog. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It backs up on you. Drink 10. 2-10: It backs up on you. Drink 5. 11-19: You plunge it. Inside: a shield. Don't ask. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You plunge it. Inside: a shield. Don't ask. Give 10.

title: Rat Captain
rules: A rat in a captain's hat with a tiny cutlass and a big grudge. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Keelhauled. Drink 10. 2-10: Keelhauled. Drink 5. 11-19: You take his hat, and his loaded die. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You take his hat, and his loaded die. Give 10.

title: The Fatberg
rules: A hundred tons of grease and wet wipes the size of a bus, and it's angry. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It absorbs a bit of you. Drink 10. 2-9: It absorbs a bit of you. Drink 5. 10-19: A chunk comes off. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! A chunk comes off. Give 8.

title: Alligator Al
rules: A twelve-foot gator in a bowling shirt who runs the sewer's only bar. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Al doesn't like your face. Drink 10. 2-9: Al doesn't like your face. Drink 5. 10-19: You bowl him a strike. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! Gutter ball, and he's in it. Everyone else drinks 3.

title: The Plumber King
rules: Crowned in a toilet seat with a plunger for a scepter. He demands tribute. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He crowns you with the seat. Finish your drink. 2-9: Plunged. Drink 5. 10-19: You snap the plunger. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You snap the plunger. Give 8.

title: Sommelier Kraken
rules: Eight arms, eight wine glasses, and every one of them is yours. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Squeezed. Drink 10. 2-9: Squeezed. Drink 5. 10-19: Calamari. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! Calamari. Give 10.

title: Last Orders Siren
rules: A siren sings one more drink, and it's beautiful. Roll d20 to resist.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You swim to her. Finish your drink. 2-9: You swim to her. Finish half your drink. 10-19: You stuff your ears with limes. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You stuff your ears with limes. Give 10.

title: The Drowned Regular
rules: He's been at the bottom of the bar since 1987 and you're on his stool. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! He takes it back. Drink 10. 2-9: He takes it back. Drink 5. 10-19: You buy him one. He fades away. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You buy him one. He fades away. Give 10.

title: Foam Leviathan
rules: A head of foam the size of a city bus rises out of the taps. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It washes over you. Drink 10. 2-9: It washes over you. Drink 5. 10-19: You blow the head off. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You blow the head off. Give 10.

title: Piranha Shots
rules: A school of piranhas lives in the shot glasses. Roll 3d6.
dice: 3d6 — 3-10: They bite back. Drink 5. 11-18: You drink them first. Give 5.

title: Your Merfolk Ex
rules: Your ex is a merfolk now and says they're doing amazing without you. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! They are. Drink 8. 2-9: They are. Drink 4. 10-19: You're doing amazing too. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You're doing amazing too. Give 10.

title: The Text-Them Eel
rules: An eel slides up and whispers: text them. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You text them. Drink 8. 2-9: You text them. Drink 4. 10-19: You bite the eel first. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You bite the eel first. Give 10.

title: Tap Mimic
rules: One of the taps is breathing. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It pours itself into you. Drink 10. 2-9: It pours itself into you. Drink 5. 10-19: You yank it out by the handle. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You yank it out by the handle. Give 8.

title: The Drowned Choir
rules: Hum a song until the table names it. 20 seconds. Nobody gets it: drink 5.

title: Rising Water
rules: The water's at your chin. Hold your breath for 30 seconds. Breathe early: drink 5.

title: The Last Round
rules: Carry every drink here across the room and back. Spill a drop: drink 5.

title: Rip Current
rules: The floor is a river now. Roll d20 to swim for it.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Swept away. Drink 8. 2-11: Swept away. Drink 4. 12-19: You ride it out. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You ride it out. Give 6.

title: Barnacle Stool
rules: You sat down. Now you can't stand up. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Fused to it. Drink 8. 2-11: Fused to it. Drink 4. 12-19: You rip free, mostly. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You rip free, mostly. Give 6.

title: Undertow Tap
rules: You lean in for a pour and the tap pulls you under. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Swallowed. Drink 8. 2-11: Swallowed. Drink 4. 12-19: You kick off the bar. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You kick off the bar. Give 6.

title: Happy Hour Eels
rules: Two eels in party hats want to buy you a drink. You know what that means. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Bitten, twice. Drink 8. 2-9: Bitten, twice. Drink 4. 10-19: You tie them in a knot. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You tie them in a knot. Give 8.

title: Sea Hag of Table Six
rules: She's run a tab since the flood, and she's settling it on you. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Settled. Drink 12. 2-12: Settled. Drink 6. 13-19: She pays you in pearls and a shield. Give 6. 20-20: Natural 20! She pays you in pearls and a shield. Give 12.

title: Shark Bartender
rules: A shark in a vest, polishing glasses with its teeth, is cutting someone off. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It's you. Drink 12. 2-12: It's you. Drink 6. 13-19: You punch it on the nose, like the documentaries said. It coughs up a loaded die. Give 6. 20-20: Natural 20! You punch it on the nose, like the documentaries said. It coughs up a loaded die. Give 12.

title: Deep Fryer Demon
rules: It'll fry anything. It's looking at your hand. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Battered. Drink 10. 2-9: Battered. Drink 5. 10-19: You throw ice in it. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You throw ice in it. Give 10.

title: Line Cook Golem
rules: Seven feet of burns and tattoos, ten tickets deep, and you're in the way. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Behind! Drink 10. 2-9: Behind! Drink 5. 10-19: You run his food. He respects you. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You run his food. He respects you. Give 10.

title: Sentient Sourdough
rules: The starter has been fed for forty years. It wants more. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It rises over you. Drink 10. 2-9: It rises over you. Drink 5. 10-19: You punch it down. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You punch it down. Give 10.

title: Garlic Breath Wraith
rules: A wraith that only ever exhales. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It breathes on you. Drink 8. 2-9: It breathes on you. Drink 4. 10-19: You hold your breath. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You hold your breath. Give 10.

title: The Expo
rules: The expo is screaming for hands, and you have hands. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Plates everywhere. Drink 10. 2-9: Plates everywhere. Drink 5. 10-19: Order up. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! Order up. Give 10.

title: Food Critic Ghoul
rules: A ghoul with a notebook. One star, and he hasn't eaten yet. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! One star. Drink 10. 2-9: One star. Drink 5. 10-19: You comp his meal. He leaves a draught as a tip. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You comp his meal. He leaves a draught as a tip. Give 8.

title: Walk-In Yeti
rules: Something lives in the walk-in, and it ate the shrimp. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It locks you in. Finish your drink. 2-9: Cold hug. Drink 5. 10-19: You lock it in. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You lock it in. Give 10.

title: Dish Pit Horror
rules: Something under the dish pit water has been eating forks. Roll 3d6.
dice: 3d6 — 3-10: It eats your fork. Drink 5. 11-18: You pull the plug. Give 5.

title: Raccoon Crew
rules: Two raccoons in chef's hats are stealing the bread. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! They take your fries too. Drink 8. 2-9: They take your fries too. Drink 4. 10-19: You chase them out. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! You chase them out. Give 8.

title: Yes, Chef
rules: For 30 seconds, answer everything anyone says with 'Yes, chef!' Miss one: drink 5.

title: Four Plates
rules: Carry four empties on one arm across the room and back. Drop one: drink 5.

title: The Hot Sauce Wall
rules: Name ten hot sauces, real or made up, in 20 seconds. Stumble: drink 5.

title: Grease Fire
rules: Somebody threw water on it. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Singed. Drink 8. 2-11: Singed. Drink 4. 12-19: You smother it with a lid. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You smother it with a lid. Give 6.

title: Wet Floor
rules: There was a sign. You ignored it. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Down. Drink 8. 2-11: Down. Drink 4. 12-19: You skate it. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You skate it. Give 6.

title: The Swinging Door
rules: One door, in and out, and a server is coming through with a full tray. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Tray to the face. Drink 8. 2-11: Tray to the face. Drink 4. 12-19: You spin past. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! You spin past. Give 6.

title: The Head Chef
rules: He's thrown a pan at everyone tonight. You're next. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! The pan. Drink 12. 2-12: The pan. Drink 6. 13-19: You say 'Heard, chef.' He's moved, and hands you his lucky die. Give 6. 20-20: Natural 20! You say 'Heard, chef.' He's moved, and hands you his lucky die. Give 12.

title: The Butcher
rules: The butcher is sharpening, and sharpening, and sharpening. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Filleted. Drink 12. 2-12: Filleted. Drink 6. 13-19: You take his apron. It's basically armor. Give 6. 20-20: Natural 20! You take his apron. It's basically armor. Give 12.

title: The Last Call Lich
rules: Lights up. Music off. It's last call forever unless you kill it. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Closing time. Everyone drinks 8. 2-10: Closing time. Everyone drinks 4. 11-19: It flickers. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! The music comes back on. Everyone else drinks 4.

title: The Bartender Below
rules: It knows your usual. It knows what you did. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It cuts you off. Drink 12. 2-10: It cuts you off. Drink 6. 11-19: You tip it. It staggers. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! You rob the tip jar. Everyone else drinks 4.

title: The Final Tab
rules: Every drink you've ever ordered, itemized, four feet long, and it has teeth. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Itemized. Drink 10. 2-10: Itemized. Drink 5. 11-19: You dispute a charge. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! Comped. Everyone else drinks 4.

title: The House Lights
rules: The lights come up, and everyone looks like that. Roll d20.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! You saw yourself. Drink 12. 2-10: You saw yourself. Drink 6. 11-19: You smash a bulb. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! Darkness again. Everyone else drinks 4.

title: Mimic Cooler
rules: A cooler in the corner is humming to itself. Open it, or walk away.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It bites. Drink 8. 2-10: It bites. Drink 4. 11-19: Cold ones, and something useful. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! Cold ones, and something useful. Give 6.

title: The Dusty Bottle
rules: A bottle older than the bar, label in Latin. Uncork it, or leave it.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Vinegar, with feelings. Drink 8. 2-10: Vinegar, with feelings. Drink 4. 11-19: Perfect. And a shield in the crate. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! Perfect. And a shield in the crate. Give 6.

title: Cursed Idol
rules: A gold idol on a plinth. Nothing bad could possibly happen. Grab it, or leave it.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! The plinth bleeds. So do you. Drink 6. 2-11: The plinth bleeds. So do you. Drink 3. 12-19: Real gold, and something rattling inside. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! Real gold, and something rattling inside. Give 8.

title: Bone Vending Machine
rules: A vending machine full of teeth and, at the back, one draught. Shake it, or leave it.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! It tips onto you. Drink 8. 2-11: It tips onto you. Drink 4. 12-19: Clunk. Give 3. 20-20: Natural 20! Clunk. Give 6.

title: Glint in the Drain
rules: Something gold is down the drain. Reach in, or don't.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Something reaches back. Drink 8. 2-11: Something reaches back. Drink 4. 12-19: A ring, and a draught still sealed. Give 4. 20-20: Natural 20! A ring, and a draught still sealed. Give 8.

title: Sunken Chest
rules: A chest under the bar, chained shut, still dry inside. Pry it open, or leave it.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Eels. Drink 10. 2-12: Eels. Drink 5. 13-19: Bone dry, and worth it. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! Bone dry, and worth it. Give 10.

title: The Back Burner
rules: A pot that's been simmering since the flood. Taste it, or leave it.
dice: 1d20 — 1-1: Natural 1! Fish heads. Drink 10. 2-12: Fish heads. Drink 5. 13-19: Best soup of your life, and a draught for later. Give 5. 20-20: Natural 20! Best soup of your life, and a draught for later. Give 10.

title: Flooded Stairs
rules: The stairs are underwater. Every trap costs one more heart. Take a smoke bomb down.

title: Happy Hour
rules: Two for one, all the way down. Every shrine heals one more heart. Everyone drinks 1.

title: Running a Tab
rules: You start two hearts short, but the bar put a shield and a draught on your tab.

title: The Lock-In
rules: Locked in until sunrise. Every boss takes one more hit to fall. Have a loaded die for it.

title: Cargo Shorts
rules: Somebody wore cargo shorts. The satchel holds four tonight, and one pocket has a draught.

title: Butterfingers
rules: Everyone's already a bit gone. The satchel holds only two, but you get two more hearts.

title: Blood Moon
rules: Blood on the moon. Every monster costs one more heart, but you start with two more.

title: Lefty Night
rules: Drink with your off hand all crawl. Caught using the other: drink 1. That's all. Probably.

title: Karaoke Night
rules: Before every boss swing, the drawer sings one line of anything. Refuse: drink 2.

title: The Regulars
rules: The bartender likes you. You start with two more hearts.

title: Thin Walls
rules: Every trial costs one more heart tonight, but every shrine heals one more.

title: Cold Open
rules: Everyone drinks before the first door. Start a heart short, with a loaded die and shield.
